<script>
(function(){
'use strict';
var e='',memory=0,mode='DEG',justResult=false,hist=[];
var HIST_KEY='miladgeo_m16_history_v127';
try{var saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(HIST_KEY)||'[]');if(Array.isArray(saved))hist=saved.slice(-100);}catch(_){hist=[];}
function q(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function fmt(n){if(!Number.isFinite(n))throw Error();var v=Math.round(n*1e12)/1e12;return String(v)}
function cleanNum(v){var s=String(v==null?'':v).trim().replace(/[٬،]/g,'').replace(/,/g,'.');if(!s)throw Error();var n=Number(s);if(!Number.isFinite(n))throw Error();return n}
function jobName(){try{var key='miladgeo_job_v85_'+(window.Telegram&&Telegram.WebApp&&Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe&&Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe.user&&Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe.user.id!=null?String(Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe.user.id):'local_guest');var j=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)||'null');if(j&&j.name&&String(j.name).trim())return String(j.name).trim();}catch(_){}return 'NO JOB'}
function render(){q('m16val').textContent=e||'0';q('m16mem').textContent='M '+(Number.isFinite(memory)?fmt(memory):'0');}
function setStatus(s){q('m16status').textContent=s}
function add(v){
 if(justResult&&/^[0-9.]$/.test(v))e='';
 justResult=false;
 if(v==='.'&&e.split(/[+\-*/()%]/).pop().includes('.'))return;
 if((v==='+'||v==='*'||v==='/')&&(!e||/[+\-*/(]$/.test(e))){if(v==='-'&&(!e||/[+\-*/(]$/.test(e))){e+='-';}else return;}
 e+=v;setStatus('READY');render();
}
function clear(){e='';justResult=false;q('m16expr').textContent='';setStatus('READY');q('m16val').textContent='0';render()}
function back(){e=e.slice(0,-1);justResult=false;setStatus('READY');render()}
function normalizeExpr(s){return String(s||'').replace(/×/g,'*').replace(/÷/g,'/').replace(/−/g,'-').replace(/[٬،]/g,'').replace(/,/g,'.').replace(/\s+/g,'')}
function tokenize(s){
 s=normalizeExpr(s);if(!s)throw Error('EMPTY');var a=[],i=0;
 while(i<s.length){var c=s[i];
  if(/[0-9.]/.test(c)){var j=i,d=0;while(j<s.length&&/[0-9.]/.test(s[j])){if(s[j]==='.')d++;j++;}if(d>1)throw Error('NUMBER');a.push(s.slice(i,j));i=j;continue;}
  if('+-*/%()'.indexOf(c)>=0){a.push(c);i++;continue;}
  throw Error('CHAR');
 }
 return a;
}
function value(){
 var t=tokenize(e),i=0;
 function primary(){var x=t[i];if(x==='+'){i++;return primary();}if(x==='-'){i++;return -primary();}if(x==='('){i++;var z=addsub();if(t[i]!==')')throw Error('PAREN');i++;return z;}if(x===undefined||!/^((\d+(\.\d*)?)|(\.\d+))$/.test(x))throw Error('NUM');i++;return Number(x)}
 function mul(){var z=primary();while(i<t.length&&['*','/','%'].indexOf(t[i])>=0){var op=t[i++],b=primary();if(op==='*')z*=b;else if(op==='/'){if(b===0)throw Error('DIV0');z/=b}else z%=b;}return z}
 function addsub(){var z=mul();while(i<t.length&&['+','-'].indexOf(t[i])>=0){var op=t[i++],b=mul();z=op==='+'?z+b:z-b}return z}
 var z=addsub();if(i!==t.length||!Number.isFinite(z))throw Error('MATH');return z;
}
function log(text){hist.push({text:String(text),time:new Date().toLocaleString()});hist=hist.slice(-100);try{localStorage.setItem(HIST_KEY,JSON.stringify(hist))}catch(_){}refreshHistory()}
function refreshHistory(){var box=q('m16history'),meta=q('m16reportMeta');if(!box)return;meta.textContent='JOB: '+jobName()+'  |  RECORDS: '+hist.length;if(!hist.length){box.textContent='No calculation yet.';return}box.innerHTML=hist.slice().reverse().map(function(x,i){return '<div class="m16-report-item"><b>'+(hist.length-i)+'.</b> '+escapeHtml(x.text)+'<br><small>'+escapeHtml(x.time)+'</small></div>'}).join('')}
function escapeHtml(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>'"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;',"'":'&#39;','"':'&quot;'}[c]})}
function equals(){try{var old=normalizeExpr(e),n=value();e=fmt(n);justResult=true;q('m16expr').textContent=old+' =';setStatus('OK');render();log(old+' = '+e)}catch(_){setStatus('ERROR');q('m16val').textContent='Error';}}
function sign(){try{var n=value();e=fmt(-n);justResult=true;q('m16expr').textContent='±('+fmt(n)+')';setStatus('OK');render();log('Sign: '+e)}catch(_){setStatus('ERROR');q('m16val').textContent='Error'}}
function percent(){try{var n=value();e=fmt(n/100);justResult=true;q('m16expr').textContent=fmt(n)+' %';setStatus('OK');render();log('Percent: '+fmt(n)+'% = '+e)}catch(_){setStatus('ERROR');q('m16val').textContent='Error'}}
function paren(){if(justResult){e='';justResult=false}var opens=(e.match(/\(/g)||[]).length,closes=(e.match(/\)/g)||[]).length;if(!e||/[+\-*/(]$/.test(e)||opens>closes)e+='(';else e+=')';setStatus('READY');render()}
function angleIn(x){return mode==='DEG'?x*Math.PI/180:mode==='GON'?x*Math.PI/200:x}
function angleOut(x){return mode==='DEG'?x*180/Math.PI:mode==='GON'?x*200/Math.PI:x}
function unary(f){try{var x=value(),y;if(f==='sin')y=Math.sin(angleIn(x));else if(f==='cos')y=Math.cos(angleIn(x));else if(f==='tan')y=Math.tan(angleIn(x));else if(f==='asin'||f==='acos'){if(x<-1||x>1)throw Error('DOMAIN');y=angleOut(f==='asin'?Math.asin(x):Math.acos(x));}else if(f==='atan')y=angleOut(Math.atan(x));else if(f==='sqrt'){if(x<0)throw Error();y=Math.sqrt(x)}else if(f==='square')y=x*x;else if(f==='recip'){if(x===0)throw Error();y=1/x}else if(f==='log'){if(x<=0)throw Error();y=Math.log10(x)}else if(f==='ln'){if(x<=0)throw Error();y=Math.log(x)}else throw Error();if(!Number.isFinite(y))throw Error();if(Math.abs(y)<1e-12)y=0;e=fmt(y);justResult=true;q('m16expr').textContent=f+'('+fmt(x)+')';setStatus('OK');render();log(f+'('+fmt(x)+') = '+e)}catch(err){setStatus('ERROR');q('m16val').textContent=(err&&err.message==='DOMAIN'?'Use a value from -1 to 1':'Error')}}
function setMode(m){mode=m;setStatus(m);q('m16expr').textContent='ANGLE MODE: '+m;render()}
function dms(){try{var n=value(),sg=n<0?-1:1,a=Math.abs(n),d=Math.floor(a),mf=(a-d)*60,m=Math.floor(mf),s=(mf-m)*60;q('m16expr').textContent=fmt(n)+'° → '+d+'° '+m+'′ '+fmt(s)+'″';setStatus('OK');log('DMS: '+fmt(n)+'° = '+d+'° '+m+'′ '+fmt(s)+'″')}catch(_){setStatus('ERROR');q('m16val').textContent='Error'}}
function mem(op){try{if(op==='mc')memory=0;else if(op==='mr'){e=fmt(memory);justResult=true}else{var n=value();memory=op==='m+'?memory+n:memory-n;justResult=true}render();setStatus('OK')}catch(_){setStatus('ERROR')}}
function openPanel(p){['survey','coord','report','quick'].forEach(function(x){var el=q('m16'+x);if(el)el.classList.remove('show')});var target=q('m16'+p);if(target)target.classList.add('show');if(p==='report')refreshHistory()}
function num(id){return cleanNum(q(id).value)}
function inverse(){try{var x1=num('m16x1'),y1=num('m16y1'),x2=num('m16x2'),y2=num('m16y2'),dx=x2-x1,dy=y2-y1,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),az=Math.atan2(dx,dy)*180/Math.PI;if(az<0)az+=360;q('m16surveyOut').innerHTML='ΔX = '+fmt(dx)+'<br>ΔY = '+fmt(dy)+'<br>Distance = '+fmt(d)+'<br>Azimuth = '+fmt(az)+'°';log('Inverse: D='+fmt(d)+' / Az='+fmt(az)+'°');}catch(_){q('m16surveyOut').textContent='مختصات X و Y را کامل و صحیح وارد کنید.'}}
function forward(){try{var x=num('m16fx'),y=num('m16fy'),d=num('m16fd'),a=num('m16fa'),r=a*Math.PI/180,nx=x+d*Math.sin(r),ny=y+d*Math.cos(r);q('m16forwardOut').innerHTML='X2 = '+fmt(nx)+'<br>Y2 = '+fmt(ny)+'<br>Distance = '+fmt(d)+'<br>Azimuth = '+fmt(a)+'°';log('Forward: X2='+fmt(nx)+' / Y2='+fmt(ny)+' / D='+fmt(d)+' / Az='+fmt(a)+'°')}catch(_){q('m16forwardOut').textContent='X / Y / Distance / Azimuth را کامل وارد کنید.'}}
function polar(){try{var a=num('m16ca'),d=num('m16cd'),r=a*Math.PI/180,dx=d*Math.sin(r),dy=d*Math.cos(r);q('m16coordOut').innerHTML='ΔX = '+fmt(dx)+'<br>ΔY = '+fmt(dy)+'<br>X offset = '+fmt(dx)+'<br>Y offset = '+fmt(dy);log('Polar: D='+fmt(d)+' / Az='+fmt(a)+'°')}catch(_){q('m16coordOut').textContent='آزیموت و فاصله را صحیح وارد کنید.'}}
function m16QuickSlope(){try{var dz=num('qDz'),hz=num('qHz');if(hz<=0)throw Error();var sd=Math.hypot(dz,hz),pct=dz/hz*100,ang=Math.atan2(dz,hz)*180/Math.PI;q('qSlopeOut').innerHTML='Slope Distance = '+fmt(sd)+'<br>Grade = '+fmt(pct)+' %<br>Vertical Angle = '+fmt(ang)+'°';log('Quick Slope: ΔZ='+fmt(dz)+' / Hz='+fmt(hz)+' / SD='+fmt(sd)+' / Grade='+fmt(pct)+'%')}catch(_){q('qSlopeOut').textContent='ΔZ و فاصله افقی را صحیح وارد کنید.'}}
function m16QuickDms(){try{var d=num('qD'),m=num('qM'),s=num('qS');if(m<0||m>=60||s<0||s>=60)throw Error();var dec=(d<0?-1:1)*(Math.abs(d)+m/60+s/3600);q('qDmsOut').innerHTML='Decimal Degree = <b>'+fmt(dec)+'°</b>';log('Quick DMS: '+fmt(d)+'° '+fmt(m)+'′ '+fmt(s)+'″ = '+fmt(dec)+'°')}catch(_){q('qDmsOut').textContent='درجه صحیح و دقیقه/ثانیه بین 0 تا 59 وارد کنید.'}}
function m16QuickReset(type){if(type==='slope'){q('qDz').value='';q('qHz').value='';q('qSlopeOut').textContent='نتیجه اینجا نمایش داده می‌شود.'}else{q('qD').value='';q('qM').value='';q('qS').value='';q('qDmsOut').textContent='نتیجه اینجا نمایش داده می‌شود.'}}
function reportText(){var lines=['MILADGEO — SURVEYING CALCULATION REPORT','JOB: '+jobName(),'DATE: '+new Date().toLocaleString(),'========================================',''];if(!hist.length)lines.push('No calculation yet.');else hist.forEach(function(x,i){lines.push((i+1)+'. '+x.text+' ['+x.time+']')});return lines.join('\n')}
function downloadBlob(name,blob){
 name=String(name||'MiladGeo_Report.txt').replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g,'_');
 try{
  if(typeof saveBlobFile==='function') return saveBlobFile(name,blob);
 }catch(err){console.error('M16 TXT export',err)}
 try{
  var url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=url;a.download=name;a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener';a.style.display='none';
  document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();
  setTimeout(function(){try{URL.revokeObjectURL(url)}catch(e){}try{a.remove()}catch(e){}},10000);
  return true;
 }catch(err){console.error('M16 blob fallback',err);showToast('دانلود فایل ناموفق بود');return false}
}
function safeFileName(){return jobName().replace(/[^\w\-]+/g,'_')||'NO_JOB'}
function m16ExportTXT(){
 try{
  var txt='\ufeff'+reportText(),name='MiladGeo_'+safeFileName()+'_Report.txt';
  var blob=new Blob([txt],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'}),file;
  try{file=new File([blob],name,{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'});}catch(_){}
  if(file&&navigator.share){
   try{var can=!navigator.canShare||navigator.canShare({files:[file]});if(can){navigator.share({files:[file],title:'MiladGeo TXT Report',text:'MiladGeo calculation report'}).then(function(){showToast('✓ TXT آماده ذخیره شد');}).catch(function(){m16DirectBlobSave(name,blob);});return false;}}catch(_){}
  }
  m16DirectBlobSave(name,blob);
 }catch(err){console.error('M16 TXT',err);showToast('⚠️ ذخیره TXT ناموفق بود');}
 return false;
}
function m16DirectBlobSave(name,blob){
 try{
  var url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=url;a.download=name;a.rel='noopener';a.target='_blank';a.style.position='fixed';a.style.left='-9999px';
  document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();
  setTimeout(function(){try{a.remove();URL.revokeObjectURL(url);}catch(_){}},15000);
  showToast('✓ ذخیره فایل شروع شد');return true;
 }catch(err){console.error('M16 direct save',err);showToast('⚠️ ذخیره مستقیم ممکن نشد؛ از Share استفاده کن');return false;}
}
function concatBytes(a,b){var r=new Uint8Array(a.length+b.length);r.set(a,0);r.set(b,a.length);return r}
function concatMany(arr){var n=arr.reduce(function(s,x){return s+x.length},0),r=new Uint8Array(n),o=0;arr.forEach(function(x){r.set(x,o);o+=x.length});return r}
function m16MakePDFBlob(){
 return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
  try{
   var lines=reportText().split('\n'),W=1240,H=1754,margin=70,lineH=36,font='28px Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif',pages=[],canvas=document.createElement('canvas'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
   canvas.width=W;canvas.height=H;ctx.font=font;ctx.textBaseline='top';
   var expanded=[];
   lines.forEach(function(line){line=String(line);if(!line){expanded.push('');return;}var max=W-margin*2,parts=[],cur='';line.split(/\s+/).forEach(function(word){var test=cur?cur+' '+word:word;if(ctx.measureText(test).width<=max)cur=test;else{if(cur)parts.push(cur);cur=word;}});if(cur)parts.push(cur);expanded.push.apply(expanded,parts.length?parts:['']);});
   var per=Math.max(1,Math.floor((H-margin*2)/lineH)),count=Math.ceil(expanded.length/per);
   function page(i){ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);ctx.fillStyle='#111';ctx.font=font;ctx.direction='ltr';ctx.textAlign='left';var start=i*per,end=Math.min(expanded.length,start+per);for(var j=start;j<end;j++){var line=expanded[j],y=margin+(j-start)*lineH;if(/[\u0600-\u06ff]/.test(line)){ctx.direction='rtl';ctx.textAlign='right';ctx.fillText(line,W-margin,y);ctx.direction='ltr';ctx.textAlign='left';}else ctx.fillText(line,margin,y);}canvas.toBlob(function(blob){if(!blob){reject(Error('PDF_IMAGE'));return;}var fr=new FileReader();fr.onload=function(){var u=new Uint8Array(fr.result),jpegs=[];jpegs.push(u);if(!page.jpegs)page.jpegs=[];page.jpegs.push(u);if(page.jpegs.length===count){try{resolve(new Blob([m16BuildPdfFromJpegs(page.jpegs,W,H)],{type:'application/pdf'}));}catch(e){reject(e);}}else page(i+1);};fr.readAsArrayBuffer(blob);},'image/jpeg',0.88);}
   page.jpegs=[];page(0);
  }catch(e){reject(e)}
 });
}
function m16BuildPdfFromJpegs(jpegs,w,h){
 var enc=new TextEncoder(),parts=[enc.encode('%PDF-1.4\n%\xff\xff\xff\xff\n')],offs=[0],pos=parts[0].length,objs=[];
 function obj(data){objs.push(data);return objs.length;}
 var catalog=obj(null),pages=obj(null),kids=[];
 jpegs.forEach(function(img,i){var im=obj({kind:'img',bytes:img}),co=obj({kind:'text',text:'q\n595 0 0 842 0 0 cm\n/Im'+(i+1)+' Do\nQ\n'}),pg=obj({kind:'text',text:''});kids.push(pg);objs[pg-1].text='<< /Type /Page /Parent '+pages+' 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 595 842] /Resources << /XObject << /Im'+(i+1)+' '+im+' 0 R >> >> /Contents '+co+' 0 R >>';});objs[catalog-1]={kind:'text',text:'<< /Type /Catalog /Pages '+pages+' 0 R >>'};objs[pages-1]={kind:'text',text:'<< /Type /Pages /Kids ['+kids.map(function(x){return x+' 0 R'}).join(' ')+'] /Count '+kids.length+' >>'};
 objs.forEach(function(o,n){offs[n+1]=pos;var head=enc.encode((n+1)+' 0 obj\n');parts.push(head);pos+=head.length;if(o.kind==='text'){var body=enc.encode(o.text);var b=concatBytes(enc.encode('<< /Length '+body.length+' >>\nstream\n'),concatBytes(body,enc.encode('endstream\nendobj\n')));parts.push(b);pos+=b.length;}else{var pre=enc.encode('<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width '+w+' /Height '+h+' /ColorSpace /DeviceRGB /BitsPerComponent 8 /Filter /DCTDecode /Length '+o.bytes.length+' >>\nstream\n');var post=enc.encode('\nendstream\nendobj\n');parts.push(pre,o.bytes,post);pos+=pre.length+o.bytes.length+post.length;}});var xref=pos,xb=enc.encode('xref\n0 '+(objs.length+1)+'\n0000000000 65535 f \n');for(var i=1;i<=objs.length;i++)xb=concatBytes(xb,enc.encode(String(offs[i]).padStart(10,'0')+' 00000 n \n'));parts.push(xb,enc.encode('trailer\n<< /Size '+(objs.length+1)+' /Root '+catalog+' 0 R >>\nstartxref\n'+xref+'\n%%EOF'));return concatMany(parts);
}
function m16ExportPDF(){
 showToast('⏳ ساخت PDF...');
 m16MakePDFBlob().then(function(blob){
  var name='MiladGeo_'+safeFileName()+'_Report.pdf',file;
  try{file=new File([blob],name,{type:'application/pdf'});}catch(_){}
  if(file&&navigator.share){
   try{var can=!navigator.canShare||navigator.canShare({files:[file]});if(can){navigator.share({files:[file],title:'MiladGeo PDF Report',text:'MiladGeo calculation report'}).then(function(){showToast('✓ PDF آماده ذخیره شد');}).catch(function(){m16DirectBlobSave(name,blob);});return;}}catch(_){}
  }
  m16DirectBlobSave(name,blob);
 }).catch(function(err){console.error('M16 PDF',err);showToast('⚠️ ساخت PDF ناموفق بود؛ دوباره تلاش کن');});
 return false;
}
function m16BuildPrintLayer(){
 var old=document.getElementById('m16PrintLayer'),oldStyle=document.getElementById('m16PrintStyle');
 if(old)old.remove();if(oldStyle)oldStyle.remove();
 var layer=document.createElement('div');layer.id='m16PrintLayer';
 var style=document.createElement('style');style.id='m16PrintStyle';
 style.textContent='@page{size:A4;margin:14mm}@media print{html,body{background:#fff!important;color:#111!important}body>*:not(#m16PrintLayer){display:none!important}#m16PrintLayer{display:block!important;position:static!important;width:auto!important;min-height:auto!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;background:#fff!important;color:#111!important;font-family:Arial,Tahoma,sans-serif!important}#m16PrintLayer .m16-print-actions{display:none!important}#m16PrintLayer h1{font-size:20px;margin:0 0 10px}#m16PrintLayer .m16-print-meta{border:1px solid #777;padding:8px;margin-bottom:12px}#m16PrintLayer pre{white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font-family:Arial,Tahoma,sans-serif;font-size:11px;line-height:1.8}}@media screen{#m16PrintLayer{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483647;overflow:auto;background:#fff;color:#111;padding:18px;box-sizing:border-box;font-family:Arial,Tahoma,sans-serif}#m16PrintLayer .m16-print-sheet{max-width:900px;margin:20px auto;padding:20px;background:#fff}#m16PrintLayer h1{font-size:20px;margin:0 0 10px}#m16PrintLayer .m16-print-meta{border:1px solid #777;padding:8px;margin-bottom:12px}#m16PrintLayer pre{white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font-family:Arial,Tahoma,sans-serif;font-size:12px;line-height:1.9}#m16PrintLayer .m16-print-actions{position:sticky;top:0;display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:8px 0;background:#fff}#m16PrintLayer button{padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid #555;border-radius:8px;background:#e7ece5;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}@media(max-width:520px){#m16PrintLayer .m16-print-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px}#m16PrintLayer button{width:100%;padding:10px 8px}}}';
 var sheet=document.createElement('div');sheet.className='m16-print-sheet';
 var title=document.createElement('h1');title.textContent='MILADGEO — SURVEYING CALCULATION REPORT';sheet.appendChild(title);
 var meta=document.createElement('div');meta.className='m16-print-meta';meta.textContent='JOB: '+jobName()+'    |    DATE: '+new Date().toLocaleString();sheet.appendChild(meta);
 var pre=document.createElement('pre');pre.textContent=reportText();sheet.appendChild(pre);
 var actions=document.createElement('div');actions.className='m16-print-actions';
 var savePDF=document.createElement('button');savePDF.type='button';savePDF.textContent='SAVE PDF';savePDF.onclick=function(){m16ExportPDF();};
 var saveTXT=document.createElement('button');saveTXT.type='button';saveTXT.textContent='SAVE TXT';saveTXT.onclick=function(){m16ExportTXT();};
 var print=document.createElement('button');print.type='button';print.textContent='PRINT';print.onclick=function(){
   try{window.focus();setTimeout(function(){try{window.print()}catch(e){showToast('چاپ توسط مرورگر پشتیبانی نشد')}} ,80);}catch(e){showToast('چاپ گزارش ناموفق بود')}
 };
 var close=document.createElement('button');close.type='button';close.textContent='بستن';close.onclick=function(){cleanup()};
 actions.appendChild(savePDF);actions.appendChild(saveTXT);actions.appendChild(print);actions.appendChild(close);sheet.appendChild(actions);layer.appendChild(sheet);document.body.appendChild(style);document.body.appendChild(layer);
 function cleanup(){try{window.removeEventListener('afterprint',cleanup)}catch(e){}if(layer.parentNode)layer.remove();if(style.parentNode)style.remove()}
 return {layer:layer,cleanup:cleanup};
}
function m16PrintReport(){
 var obj=m16BuildPrintLayer();
 try{
  window.addEventListener('afterprint',obj.cleanup,{once:true});
  setTimeout(function(){try{window.focus();window.print()}catch(e){showToast('چاپ توسط مرورگر پشتیبانی نشد؛ از منوی مرورگر Print استفاده کن')}} ,250);
 }catch(e){obj.cleanup();showToast('چاپ گزارش ناموفق بود')}
 return false;
}
function m16ClearHistory(){hist=[];try{localStorage.removeItem(HIST_KEY)}catch(_){}refreshHistory();showToast('Report cleared')}
window.m16Add=add;window.m16Clear=clear;window.m16Back=back;window.m16Unary=unary;window.m16Equals=equals;window.m16Sign=sign;window.m16Percent=percent;window.m16Paren=paren;window.m16Dms=dms;window.m16Mode=setMode;window.m16Mem=mem;window.m16Open=openPanel;window.m16Inverse=inverse;window.m16Forward=forward;window.m16Polar=polar;window.m16ClearHistory=m16ClearHistory;window.m16QuickSlope=m16QuickSlope;window.m16QuickDms=m16QuickDms;window.m16QuickReset=m16QuickReset;window.m16ExportTXT=m16ExportTXT;window.m16ExportPDF=m16ExportPDF;window.m16PrintReport=m16PrintReport;
render();refreshHistory();
})();

/* V24 — AREA Excel PENZD import + polygon area */
function areaExcelNum(v){
  if(v===null||v===undefined||v==='') return NaN;
  var t=String(v).trim().replace(/[٬،]/g,',').replace(/\s/g,'');
  if(t.indexOf(',')>=0 && t.indexOf('.')<0) t=t.replace(',','.');
  else t=t.replace(/,/g,'');
  var n=Number(t); return isFinite(n)?n:NaN;
}
function areaExcelRowsFromSheet(rows){
  if(!rows || !rows.length) return [];
  var first=rows[0]||[], hasHeader=false, header={};
  for(var j=0;j<first.length;j++){
    var h=String(first[j]??'').trim().toLowerCase();
    if(h==='point'||h==='p'||h==='easting'||h==='e'||h==='x'||h==='northing'||h==='n'||h==='y'||h==='z'||h==='elevation'||h==='description'||h==='dp'){hasHeader=true;}
    header[h]=j;
  }
  var start=hasHeader?1:0, out=[];
  function idx(names,fallback){for(var k=0;k<names.length;k++){if(header[names[k]]!==undefined)return header[names[k]];}return fallback;}
  var ip=idx(['point','p'],0), ix=idx(['easting','e','x'],1), iy=idx(['northing','n','y'],2), iz=idx(['z','elevation','elev'],3), id=idx(['description','dp','desc'],4);
  for(var i=start;i<rows.length;i++){
    var r=rows[i]||[], x=areaExcelNum(r[ix]), y=areaExcelNum(r[iy]), z=areaExcelNum(r[iz]);
    if(!isFinite(x)||!isFinite(y)) continue;
    out.push({no:String(r[ip]??('P'+String(out.length+1).padStart(3,'0'))).trim(),x:x,y:y,z:isFinite(z)?z:0,dp:String(r[id]??'').trim()});
  }
  return out;
}
function areaExcelCalculateRows(rows){
  var n=rows.length;
  if(n<3) return {ok:false,msg:'حداقل ۳ نقطه برای محاسبه مساحت لازم است.'};
  var sum=0;
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var a=rows[i],b=rows[(i+1)%n];sum += a.x*b.y - b.x*a.y;}
  var area=Math.abs(sum)/2;
  var per=0;
  for(var k=0;k<n;k++){var a2=rows[k],b2=rows[(k+1)%n];per += Math.hypot(b2.x-a2.x,b2.y-a2.y);}
  return {ok:true,area:area,perimeter:per};
}
function areaImportExcel(){
  var inp=$("areaExcelFile"),status=$("areaExcelStatus"),pre=$("areaExcelPreview");
  if(!inp||!inp.files||!inp.files[0]){showToast('ابتدا فایل Excel را انتخاب کن');return false;}
  if(typeof XLSX==='undefined'){showToast('Excel engine not available');return false;}
  var file=inp.files[0], reader=new FileReader();
  reader.onload=function(e){
    try{
      var wb=XLSX.read(new Uint8Array(e.target.result),{type:'array'});
      var ws=wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]];
      var rows=XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws,{header:1,defval:''});
      var pts=areaExcelRowsFromSheet(rows);
      if(!pts.length){status.innerHTML='<span class="excel-bad">✗ No valid PENZD rows found</span>';return;}
      var calc=areaExcelCalculateRows(pts);
      if(pre){pre.style.display='block';pre.textContent=pts.slice(0,30).map(function(p){return p.no+' | X '+p.x+' | Y '+p.y+' | Z '+p.z+(p.dp?' | '+p.dp:'');}).join('\\n')+(pts.length>30?'\\n...':'');}
      if(!calc.ok){status.innerHTML='<span class="excel-bad">✗ '+calc.msg+'</span>';return;}
      status.innerHTML='<span class="excel-ok">✓ PENZD IMPORTED</span> — '+pts.length+' points — Area: <b>'+calc.area.toFixed(3)+'</b> — Perimeter: <b>'+calc.perimeter.toFixed(3)+'</b>';
      var r=$("areaResult"); if(r) r.innerHTML='<div class="area-result"><div>EXCEL PENZD — '+pts.length+' POINTS</div><div class="area-value">'+calc.area.toFixed(3)+' m²</div><div>Perimeter: '+calc.perimeter.toFixed(3)+' m</div></div>';
      /* Load imported coordinates into the existing Area point rows without changing Point List. */
      areaPointCount=Math.max(3,pts.length); renderAreaPoints();
      for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i++){
        var xel=$("areaX"+i), yel=$("areaY"+i);
        if(xel)xel.value=pts[i].x; if(yel)yel.value=pts[i].y;
      }
      if(typeof drawAreaSketch==='function') drawAreaSketch();
      showToast(pts.length+' PENZD points imported — area calculated ✓');
    }catch(err){status.innerHTML='<span class="excel-bad">✗ Excel read error: '+escapeHTML(String(err.message||err))+'</span>';}
  };
  reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
  return false;
}
function clearAreaExcel(){
  var f=$("areaExcelFile"),s=$("areaExcelStatus"),p=$("areaExcelPreview");
  if(f)f.value=''; if(s)s.textContent='هنوز فایل Excel انتخاب نشده است.'; if(p){p.style.display='none';p.textContent='';}
  return false;
}
</script>
<script>
/* MENU 17 — Google Earth satellite map only, no external map library required. */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  /* MiladGeo branding: Menu 17 opens at Milad Tower by default. */
  var MILAD_TOWER_LAT=35.744841;
  var MILAD_TOWER_LNG=51.375337;
  var state={lat:MILAD_TOWER_LAT,lng:MILAD_TOWER_LNG,zoom:14,mapLayer:"hybrid",gridVisible:false,gridMode:"geo",ready:false,drag:false,p1:null,p2:null,lastTap:0,raf:0,tap:null,drawMode:null,drawPoints:[],drawShapes:[],stakePoints:[],profileBoundary:[],profileMode:false};
  /* V388 — persist completed real-field line/area drawings inside the active JOB. */
  function ensureRealMeasureJob(){
    try{
      if(typeof job==='undefined'||!job||typeof job!=='object')return null;
      if(!job.realMeasure||typeof job.realMeasure!=='object')job.realMeasure={lines:[],areas:[]};
      if(!Array.isArray(job.realMeasure.lines))job.realMeasure.lines=[];
      if(!Array.isArray(job.realMeasure.areas))job.realMeasure.areas=[];
      return job.realMeasure;
    }catch(e){return null}
  }
  function syncRealMeasureJob(){
    try{
      var rm=ensureRealMeasureJob(); if(!rm)return;
      rm.lines=[];rm.areas=[];
      for(var i=0;i<state.drawShapes.length;i++){
        var sh=state.drawShapes[i];
        if(!sh||!sh.realMeasure||sh.type!=='line'||!Array.isArray(sh.points)||sh.points.length<2)continue;
        var pts=sh.points.map(function(p){return {lat:Number(p.lat),lng:Number(p.lng)};});
        if(sh.measureType==='area')rm.areas.push(pts);else rm.lines.push(pts);
      }
      saveJSON(JOB_KEY,job);
    }catch(e){console.error('M17_SYNC_REAL_JOB',e)}
  }
  function restoreRealMeasureJob(){
    try{
      if(state.drawShapes.some(function(sh){return sh&&sh.realMeasure;}))return;
      var rm=ensureRealMeasureJob();if(!rm)return;
      (rm.lines||[]).forEach(function(pts){if(Array.isArray(pts)&&pts.length>=2)state.drawShapes.push({type:'line',points:pts.map(function(p){return {lat:Number(p.lat),lng:Number(p.lng)}}),measureType:'line',realMeasure:true});});
      (rm.areas||[]).forEach(function(pts){if(Array.isArray(pts)&&pts.length>=3)state.drawShapes.push({type:'line',points:pts.map(function(p){return {lat:Number(p.lat),lng:Number(p.lng)}}),measureType:'area',realMeasure:true});});
    }catch(e){console.error('M17_RESTORE_REAL_JOB',e)}
  }
  var TILE=256, MAXZ=20, tilesEl, mapEl, coordBox, tapMarker, areaBox;
  function q(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
  function clampLat(lat){return Math.max(-85.05112878,Math.min(85.05112878,lat))}
  function wrapLng(lng){lng=((lng+180)%360+360)%360-180;return lng}
  function worldXY(lat,lng,z){
    var n=Math.pow(2,z),la=clampLat(lat),rad=la*Math.PI/180;
    return {x:(lng+180)/360*n*TILE,y:(1-Math.log(Math.tan(rad)+1/Math.cos(rad))/Math.PI)/2*n*TILE};
  }
  function setImageDragDisabled(img){img.draggable=false;img.setAttribute('draggable','false')}
  function latLngFromPoint(px,py){
    var rect=mapEl.getBoundingClientRect(),w=Math.max(1,rect.width),h=Math.max(1,rect.height);
    var c=worldXY(state.lat,state.lng,state.zoom);
    var wx=c.x+(px-w/2), wy=c.y+(py-h/2), n=Math.pow(2,state.zoom)*TILE;
    var lng=wx/n*360-180;
    var merc=1-2*wy/n;
    var lat=180/Math.PI*Math.atan(Math.sinh(Math.PI*merc));
    return {lat:clampLat(lat),lng:wrapLng(lng)};
  }
  function wgs84ToUTM(lat,lon){
    var a=6378137.0, eccSq=0.0066943799901413165, k0=0.9996;
    var latRad=lat*Math.PI/180, lonRad=lon*Math.PI/180;
    var zone=Math.floor((lon+180)/6)+1;
    var lon0=(zone-1)*6-180+3;
    var lon0Rad=lon0*Math.PI/180;
    var eccPrimeSq=eccSq/(1-eccSq);
    var N=a/Math.sqrt(1-eccSq*Math.sin(latRad)*Math.sin(latRad));
    var T=Math.tan(latRad)*Math.tan(latRad);
    var C=eccPrimeSq*Math.cos(latRad)*Math.cos(latRad);
    var A=Math.cos(latRad)*(lonRad-lon0Rad);
    var M=a*((1-eccSq/4-3*eccSq*eccSq/64-5*eccSq*eccSq*eccSq/256)*latRad
      -(3*eccSq/8+3*eccSq*eccSq/32+45*eccSq*eccSq*eccSq/1024)*Math.sin(2*latRad)
      +(15*eccSq*eccSq/256+45*eccSq*eccSq*eccSq/1024)*Math.sin(4*latRad)
      -(35*eccSq*eccSq*eccSq/3072)*Math.sin(6*latRad));
    var x=k0*N*(A+(1-T+C)*A*A*A/6+(5-18*T+T*T+72*C-58*eccPrimeSq)*A*A*A*A*A/120)+500000;
    var y=k0*(M+N*Math.tan(latRad)*(A*A/2+(5-T+9*C+4*C*C)*A*A*A*A/24+(61-58*T+T*T+600*C-330*eccPrimeSq)*A*A*A*A*A*A/720));
    var hemi=lat<0?'S':'N';
    if(lat<0)y+=10000000;
    return {zone:zone,hemisphere:hemi,x:x,y:y};
  }
  function screenPointFromLatLng(lat,lng){
    var rect=mapEl.getBoundingClientRect(),w=Math.max(1,rect.width),h=Math.max(1,rect.height);
    var c=worldXY(state.lat,state.lng,state.zoom),p=worldXY(lat,lng,state.zoom),n=Math.pow(2,state.zoom)*TILE;
    var dx=p.x-c.x;if(dx>n/2)dx-=n;else if(dx<-n/2)dx+=n;
    return {x:w/2+dx,y:h/2+(p.y-c.y)};
  }
  function clearAreaBox(){if(areaBox){areaBox.style.display='none';areaBox.textContent='مساحت: —';}}
  function showAreaBox(area){if(areaBox){areaBox.textContent='مساحت: '+area.toFixed(2)+' مترمربع';areaBox.style.display='block';}}
  function utmArea(points){
    if(!points||points.length<3)return 0;
    var u=[],i;
    for(i=0;i<points.length;i++){var z=wgs84ToUTM(points[i].lat,points[i].lng);u.push({x:z.x,y:z.y});}
    var sum=0;
    for(i=0;i<u.length;i++){var j=(i+1)%u.length;sum+=u[i].x*u[j].y-u[j].x*u[i].y;}
    return Math.abs(sum)/2;
  }
  function clearSvg(){var svg=q('m17DrawSvg');if(svg)svg.innerHTML='';}
  function drawSvgEl(name,attrs,cls){var svg=q('m17DrawSvg');if(!svg)return null;var el=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg',name);for(var k in attrs)el.setAttribute(k,attrs[k]);if(cls)el.setAttribute('class',cls);svg.appendChild(el);return el;}
  function m17DistanceMeters(a,b){
    try{
      var ua=wgs84ToUTM(Number(a.lat),Number(a.lng));
      var ub=wgs84ToUTM(Number(b.lat),Number(b.lng));
      var dx=Number(ub.x)-Number(ua.x),dy=Number(ub.y)-Number(ua.y);
      return Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
    }catch(e){return NaN;}
  }
  function m17DrawDistanceLabel(a,b){
    var pa=screenPointFromLatLng(a.lat,a.lng),pb=screenPointFromLatLng(b.lat,b.lng);
    var d=m17DistanceMeters(a,b);
    if(!isFinite(d))return;
    var mx=(pa.x+pb.x)/2,my=(pa.y+pb.y)/2;
    var text=d.toFixed(2)+' m';
    /* Distance is text-only: no black/colored box behind it, including JPG/PDF exports. */
    drawSvgEl('text',{x:mx,y:my},'m17-distance-text').textContent=text;
  }
  function renderDrawings(){
    var svg=q('m17DrawSvg');if(!svg||!mapEl)return;clearSvg();
    /* V330: keep the DEM/topography boundary visible while selecting an elevation profile. */
    if(state.profileMode&&state.profileBoundary&&state.profileBoundary.length>=3){
      var bp=[];
      for(var bi=0;bi<state.profileBoundary.length;bi++){
        var bpp=screenPointFromLatLng(state.profileBoundary[bi].lat,state.profileBoundary[bi].lng);
        bp.push(bpp.x+','+bpp.y);
      }
      drawSvgEl('polygon',{points:bp.join(' ')},'m17-profile-boundary');
      var bminx=Infinity,bminy=Infinity,bmaxx=-Infinity,bmaxy=-Infinity;
      for(var bj=0;bj<state.profileBoundary.length;bj++){
        var bbp=screenPointFromLatLng(state.profileBoundary[bj].lat,state.profileBoundary[bj].lng);
        bminx=Math.min(bminx,bbp.x);bminy=Math.min(bminy,bbp.y);bmaxx=Math.max(bmaxx,bbp.x);bmaxy=Math.max(bmaxy,bbp.y);
      }
      drawSvgEl('text',{x:(bminx+bmaxx)/2,y:Math.max(18,bminy-8),'font-size':'13','font-family':'Arial,Tahoma,sans-serif','font-weight':'900',fill:'#ffffff','paint-order':'stroke','stroke':'#111111','stroke-width':'4','stroke-linejoin':'round'},'m17-profile-boundary-label').textContent='محدوده انتخاب‌شده';
    }
    /* V252: stake-out points are independent from drawing points and remain visible in every mode. */
    for(var si=0;si<state.stakePoints.length;si++){
      var sp=state.stakePoints[si],spp=screenPointFromLatLng(sp.lat,sp.lng);
      drawSvgEl('circle',{cx:spp.x,cy:spp.y,r:10},'m17-stake-point');
      drawSvgEl('text',{x:spp.x+13,y:spp.y-12},'m17-stake-label').textContent=String(sp.name||('P'+(si+1)));
    }
    var globalPointNo=0,pointShapes=[];
    for(var i=0;i<state.drawShapes.length;i++){
      var sh=state.drawShapes[i];
      /* Point mode shows only point markers and distances between consecutive points.
         No line/polyline is created for these distances. */
      if(state.drawMode==='point' && sh.type!=='point') continue;
      if((state.drawMode==='line'||state.drawMode==='area') && sh.type!=='line') continue;
      var pts=[];
      for(var j=0;j<sh.points.length;j++)pts.push(screenPointFromLatLng(sh.points[j].lat,sh.points[j].lng));
      if(sh.type==='point'){
        if(pts[0]){
          drawSvgEl('circle',{cx:pts[0].x,cy:pts[0].y,r:8},'m17-point');
          pointShapes.push(sh);
        }
      }
      if(sh.type==='line'&&pts.length>1){
        var lp=pts.map(function(p){return p.x+','+p.y;}).join(' ');
        if(sh.measureType==='area') drawSvgEl('polygon',{points:lp},'m17-poly');
        else drawSvgEl('polyline',{points:lp},'m17-line');
      }
      for(var jl=0;jl<pts.length;jl++){
        globalPointNo++;
        drawSvgEl('text',{x:pts[jl].x+11,y:pts[jl].y-11,'font-size':'14','font-family':'Arial,Tahoma,sans-serif','font-weight':'900',fill:'#ffffff','paint-order':'stroke','stroke':'#111111','stroke-width':'4','stroke-linejoin':'round'},'m17-point-label').textContent='P'+globalPointNo;
      }
    }
    /* Requested: in Point mode show only the numeric distance between consecutive points.
       There is deliberately NO line between the points. */
    if(state.drawMode==='point' && pointShapes.length>=2){
      for(var pi=1;pi<pointShapes.length;pi++){
        m17DrawDistanceLabel(pointShapes[pi-1].points[0],pointShapes[pi].points[0]);
      }
    }
    if(state.drawMode&&state.drawPoints.length){
      var live=[];for(var k=0;k<state.drawPoints.length;k++)live.push(screenPointFromLatLng(state.drawPoints[k].lat,state.drawPoints[k].lng));
      if((state.drawMode==='line'||state.drawMode==='area')&&live.length>1){
        var livePts=live.map(function(p){return p.x+','+p.y;}).join(' ');
        if(state.drawMode==='area'&&live.length>=3)drawSvgEl('polygon',{points:livePts},'m17-poly');else drawSvgEl('polyline',{points:livePts},'m17-line');
      }
      for(var qx=0;qx<live.length;qx++){
        drawSvgEl('circle',{cx:live[qx].x,cy:live[qx].y,r:state.profileMode?8:6},'m17-point');
        if(state.profileMode){
          var lab=qx===0?'A':(qx===1?'B':'');
          if(lab)drawSvgEl('text',{x:live[qx].x+11,y:live[qx].y-11,'font-size':'16','font-family':'Arial,Tahoma,sans-serif','font-weight':'900',fill:'#ffffff','paint-order':'stroke','stroke':'#111111','stroke-width':'4','stroke-linejoin':'round'},'m17-profile-point-label').textContent=lab;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  var m17HintTimer=0;
  function updateUndoPointButton(){
    var b=q('m17UndoPointBtn');
    if(!b)return;
    var hasPoint=(state.drawMode==='point') && state.drawShapes.some(function(sh){return sh.type==='point'&&sh.points&&sh.points.length>0;});
    var hasLive=(state.drawMode==='line'||state.drawMode==='area') && state.drawPoints && state.drawPoints.length>0;
    var hasLine=(state.drawMode==='line'||state.drawMode==='area') && state.drawShapes.some(function(sh){return sh.type==='line'&&sh.points&&sh.points.length>0;});
    b.classList.toggle('show',!!(hasPoint||hasLive||hasLine));
  }
  function undoLastDrawPoint(){
    /* Point mode: remove the latest measured point marker. If that point was
       newly added to JOB by the real-measure bridge, remove that JOB record too. */    if(state.drawMode==='point'){
      var pidx=-1;
      for(var pi=state.drawShapes.length-1;pi>=0;pi--){
        if(state.drawShapes[pi].type==='point'&&state.drawShapes[pi].points&&state.drawShapes[pi].points.length){pidx=pi;break;}
      }
      if(pidx<0)return false;
      var pshape=state.drawShapes[pidx];
      state.drawShapes.splice(pidx,1);
      if(pshape.jobPointAdded && pshape.jobPointId && Array.isArray(points)){
        var before=points.length;
        points=points.filter(function(jp){return String(jp&&jp.id)!==String(pshape.jobPointId);});
        if(points.length!==before){saveJSON(POINTS_KEY,points);refreshPoints();updateAllUI();try{if(window.miladJobAutoSync362)window.miladJobAutoSync362(POINTS_KEY);}catch(e){}}
      }
      renderDrawings();
      renderSoon();
      updateUndoPointButton();
      showToast('آخرین نقطه حذف شد ↶');
      return false;
    }
    if(state.drawMode!=='line'&&state.drawMode!=='area')return false;
    var changed=false;
    if(state.drawPoints&&state.drawPoints.length){
      state.drawPoints.pop();
      changed=true;
    }else{
      var idx=-1;
      for(var i=state.drawShapes.length-1;i>=0;i--){
        if(state.drawShapes[i].type==='line'&&state.drawShapes[i].points&&state.drawShapes[i].points.length){idx=i;break;}
      }
      if(idx>=0){
        var pts=state.drawShapes[idx].points;
        if(pts.length>1){
          pts.pop();
          state.drawPoints=pts.slice();
          state.drawShapes.splice(idx,1);
          changed=true;
        }else{
          state.drawShapes.splice(idx,1);
          state.drawPoints=[];
          changed=true;
        }
      }
    }
    if(!changed)return false;
    syncRealMeasureJob();
    if(state.drawMode==='area' && state.drawPoints.length>=3)showAreaBox(utmArea(state.drawPoints));
    else if(state.drawMode==='area'){
      var lastLine=m17FirstLine();
      if(lastLine&&lastLine.points.length>=3)showAreaBox(utmArea(lastLine.points));
      else clearAreaBox();
    }else clearAreaBox();
    renderDrawings();
    renderSoon();
    updateUndoPointButton();
    showToast('آخرین نقطه حذف شد ↶');
    return false;
  }
  function setDrawMode(mode){
    /* Keep completed drawings. A new line starts a new drawing without deleting previous ones. */
    if(mode==='line'||mode==='area'){
      state.drawPoints=[];
      clearAreaBox();
    }else{
      state.drawPoints=[];
    }
    state.drawMode=mode==='clear'?null:mode;
    if(mode!=='area' && mode!=='point')clearAreaBox();
    var bs=document.querySelectorAll('#m17DrawToolbar button');for(var i=0;i<bs.length;i++)bs[i].classList.toggle('active',bs[i].getAttribute('data-mode')===state.drawMode);
    var hint=q('m17DrawHint');
    if(m17HintTimer){clearTimeout(m17HintTimer);m17HintTimer=0;}
    if(hint){
      var t=mode==='point'
        ?'نقطه: روی محل موردنظر لمس کنید.<br>مختصات نقطه همان لحظه نمایش داده می‌شود.'
        :(mode==='line'
          ?'خط: نقطه اول را لمس کنید، سپس نقاط بعدی را لمس کنید.<br>برای پایان، دوباره «خط» را بزنید.'
          :(mode==='area'
            ?'مساحت: رأس‌ها را یکی‌یکی لمس کنید.<br>برای پایان و محاسبه مساحت، دوباره «مساحت» را بزنید.'
            :''));
      hint.innerHTML=t;
      hint.style.display=t?'block':'none';
      hint.style.visibility=t?'visible':'hidden';
      if(t){
        m17HintTimer=setTimeout(function(){
          hint.style.display='none';
          hint.style.visibility='hidden';
        },5000);
      }
    }
    if(mode==='clear'){
      /* Drawing cleanup must never delete stake-out points. */
      state.drawPoints=[];
      state.drawShapes=[];
      /* V334: the topography boundary is a separate profile overlay, so it
         must be cleared explicitly as well. */
      state.profileMode=false;
      state.profileBoundary=[];
      clearSvg();
      clearAreaBox();
      renderDrawings();
      renderSoon();
    }
    updateUndoPointButton();
  }
  function drawTap(lat,lng){
    if(!state.drawMode)return false;
    var pt={lat:lat,lng:lng};
    if(state.drawMode==='point'){
      var pointShape={type:'point',points:[pt],jobPointAdded:false,jobPointId:null};
      state.drawShapes.push(pointShape);
      state.drawPoints=[];
      try{
        if(typeof window.miladgeoAddMeasuredPointToJob==='function'){
          var beforeCount=Array.isArray(points)?points.length:0;
          var addedJob=window.miladgeoAddMeasuredPointToJob(lat,lng,0,'MEASURE');
          var afterCount=Array.isArray(points)?points.length:beforeCount;
          if(afterCount>beforeCount && addedJob){pointShape.jobPointAdded=true;pointShape.jobPointId=addedJob.id||null;}
        }
      }catch(e){console.error('M17_SAVE_POINT_JOB',e);}
      renderDrawings();
      updateUndoPointButton();
      return true;
    }
    if(state.drawMode==='circle'){state.drawPoints.push(pt);if(state.drawPoints.length===2){state.drawShapes.push({type:'circle',points:state.drawPoints.slice()});state.drawPoints=[];}renderDrawings();return true;}
    state.drawPoints.push(pt);
    /* Profile mode: keep A and B on the map until the user explicitly confirms. */
    if((state.profileMode || window.m4ProfileSelecting===true) && state.drawMode==='line'){
      if(state.drawPoints.length>2)state.drawPoints=state.drawPoints.slice(-2);
      renderDrawings();
      updateUndoPointButton();
      var pcb=document.getElementById('m4ProfileConfirmBar'),pbtn=document.getElementById('m4ProfileConfirmBtn');
      if(pcb)pcb.style.display=state.drawPoints.length>=2?'block':'none';
      if(pbtn)pbtn.classList.toggle('enabled',state.drawPoints.length>=2);
      return true;
    }
    /* Area mode shows live polygon area; line mode shows length only. */
    if(state.drawMode==='area' && state.drawPoints.length>=3){
      showAreaBox(utmArea(state.drawPoints));
    }
    renderDrawings();updateUndoPointButton();return true;
  }
  function finishCurrentDrawing(){
    if((state.drawMode==='line'||state.drawMode==='area')&&state.drawPoints.length>=2){
      var pts=state.drawPoints.slice();
      state.drawShapes.push({type:'line',points:pts,measureType:state.drawMode==='area'?'area':'line',realMeasure:true});
      syncRealMeasureJob();
      if(state.drawMode==='area'&&pts.length>=3)showAreaBox(utmArea(pts));
      else clearAreaBox();
    }
    state.drawPoints=[];renderDrawings();updateUndoPointButton();
  }
  window.m17FinishCurrentDrawing=finishCurrentDrawing;
  window.m17GetDrawPoints=function(){return state.drawPoints?state.drawPoints.slice():[];};
  window.m17UpdateEntryButton=window.m17UpdateEntryButton||function(){};
  window.m17FinishMeasureEntry=window.m17FinishMeasureEntry||function(){return false;};
  function m17UtmToWgs84(x,y,zone,northern){
    var a=6378137.0,eccSq=0.0066943799901413165,k0=0.9996,eccPrimeSq=eccSq/(1-eccSq);
    var e1=(1-Math.sqrt(1-eccSq))/(1+Math.sqrt(1-eccSq)),x0=Number(x)-500000,y0=Number(y);
    if(!northern)y0-=10000000;
    var M=y0/k0,mu=M/(a*(1-eccSq/4-3*eccSq*eccSq/64-5*eccSq*eccSq*eccSq/256));
    var J1=3*e1/2-27*Math.pow(e1,3)/32,J2=21*e1*e1/16-55*Math.pow(e1,4)/32,J3=151*Math.pow(e1,3)/96,J4=1097*Math.pow(e1,4)/512;
    var fp=mu+J1*Math.sin(2*mu)+J2*Math.sin(4*mu)+J3*Math.sin(6*mu)+J4*Math.sin(8*mu);

    var R1=a*(1-eccSq)/Math.pow(1-eccSq*Math.sin(fp)*Math.sin(fp),1.5),D=x0/(N1*k0);
    var lat=fp-(N1*Math.tan(fp)/R1)*(D*D/2-(5+3*T1+10*C1-4*C1*C1-9*eccPrimeSq)*Math.pow(D,4)/24+(61+90*T1+298*C1+45*T1*T1-252*eccPrimeSq-3*C1*C1)*Math.pow(D,6)/720);
    var lon0=((Number(zone)-1)*6-180+3)*Math.PI/180;
    var lon=lon0+(D-(1+2*T1+C1)*Math.pow(D,3)/6+(5-2*C1+28*T1-3*C1*C1+8*eccPrimeSq+24*T1*T1)*Math.pow(D,5)/120)/Math.cos(fp);
    return {lat:lat*180/Math.PI,lng:lon*180/Math.PI};

  var m17StakeMethod='utm';
  function m17RenderStakeList(){
    var box=q('m17StakeList');if(!box)return;
    if(!state.stakePoints.length){box.textContent='No stake-out points yet.';return;}
    box.innerHTML=state.stakePoints.map(function(p,i){var u=wgs84ToUTM(p.lat,p.lng);return '<div>P'+(i+1)+' — X '+u.x.toFixed(2)+' | Y '+u.y.toFixed(2)+' | '+p.lat.toFixed(7)+', '+p.lng.toFixed(7)+'</div>';}).join('');
  }
  function m17SetStakeMethod(method){

    var u=q('m17StakeUtmFields'),g=q('m17StakeGeoFields'),bu=q('m17StakeMethodUtm'),bg=q('m17StakeMethodGeo');
    if(u)u.style.display=method==='utm'?'block':'none';if(g)g.style.display=method==='geo'?'block':'none';

  function m17OpenStake(){

  var m17LiveTarget=null,m17LiveWatchId=null,m17LiveUser=null,m17LiveTargetIndex=-1,m17LiveTargetLabel='';
  function m17FormatSigned(v){if(!isFinite(v))return '—';return (v>=0?'+':'−')+Math.abs(v).toFixed(2);}
  function m17LiveDirection(de,dn){
    if(!isFinite(de)||!isFinite(dn))return 'منتظر موقعیت GPS…';
    if(Math.hypot(de,dn)<0.75)return '🎯 روی نقطه هدف';
    var ns=dn>=0?'شمال':'جنوب',ew=de>=0?'شرق':'غرب';
    if(Math.abs(dn)<0.75)return '➡ '+(de>=0?'شرق':'غرب');
    if(Math.abs(de)<0.75)return '⬆ '+ns;
    return (dn>=0?'↗':'↘')+' '+ns+' — '+ew;
  }
  function m17LiveSetText(id,val){var e=q(id);if(e)e.textContent=val;}
  function m17LiveScreenPoint(lat,lng){
    if(!mapEl)return {x:window.innerWidth/2,y:window.innerHeight/2};
    var r=mapEl.getBoundingClientRect(),c=worldXY(state.lat,state.lng,state.zoom),p=worldXY(lat,lng,state.zoom);
    var n=Math.pow(2,state.zoom)*TILE,dx=p.x-c.x,dy=p.y-c.y;
    if(dx>n/2)dx-=n;if(dx<-n/2)dx+=n;
    return {x:r.left+r.width/2+dx,y:r.top+r.height/2+dy};
  }
  function m17LivePlaceMarker(id,lat,lng,show){
    var e=q(id);if(!e)return;var p=m17LiveScreenPoint(lat,lng);e.style.left=p.x+'px';e.style.top=p.y+'px';e.style.display=show?'block':'none';
  }
  function m17LiveFitView(){
    if(!m17LiveTarget||!m17LiveUser)return;
    var midLat=(m17LiveTarget.lat+m17LiveUser.lat)/2,midLng=(m17LiveTarget.lng+m17LiveUser.lng)/2;
    var d=m17DistanceMeters(m17LiveTarget,m17LiveUser),z=d<250?17:d<600?16:d<1500?15:d<3500?14:d<8000?13:d<18000?12:d<40000?11:10;
    /* V258: keep the live target/user and guide line inside the visible map area,
       above the bottom live panel. The panel remains unchanged; only the map
       center is shifted upward so the real geographic positions are not hidden. */
    var r=mapEl?mapEl.getBoundingClientRect():{top:0,height:window.innerHeight};
    var card=q('m17LiveStakeModal')?q('m17LiveStakeModal').querySelector('.m17-live-stake-card'):null;
    var bottom=card?card.getBoundingClientRect().top:(r.top+r.height*.70);
    var visibleH=Math.max(260,bottom-r.top);
    var desiredY=r.top+visibleH*.50;
    var screenCenterY=r.top+r.height*.50;
    var n=Math.pow(2,z)*TILE;
    var midW=worldXY(midLat,midLng,z);
    var shiftedCenterY=midW.y-(desiredY-screenCenterY);
    var merc=1-2*shiftedCenterY/n;
    var shiftedLat=clampLat(180/Math.PI*Math.atan(Math.sinh(Math.PI*merc)));
    state.lat=shiftedLat;state.lng=midLng;state.zoom=z;renderSoon();
  }
  function m17LiveUpdateMap(){
    if(!m17LiveTarget)return;
    if(m17LiveUser)m17LiveFitView();
    setTimeout(function(){
      if(!m17LiveTarget)return;
      m17LivePlaceMarker('m17LiveTargetMarker',m17LiveTarget.lat,m17LiveTarget.lng,true);
      if(m17LiveUser)m17LivePlaceMarker('m17LiveUserMarker',m17LiveUser.lat,m17LiveUser.lng,true);
      var line=q('m17LiveGuideLine');
      if(line&&m17LiveUser){var a=m17LiveScreenPoint(m17LiveUser.lat,m17LiveUser.lng),b=m17LiveScreenPoint(m17LiveTarget.lat,m17LiveTarget.lng),dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y;line.style.left=a.x+'px';line.style.top=a.y+'px';line.style.width=Math.hypot(dx,dy)+'px';line.style.transform='rotate('+Math.atan2(dy,dx)+'rad)';line.style.display='block';}
    },30);
  }
  function m17LiveGridAzimuth(de,dn){
    if(!isFinite(de)||!isFinite(dn)||Math.hypot(de,dn)<0.001)return NaN;
    var a=Math.atan2(de,dn)*180/Math.PI;
    if(a<0)a+=360;
    return a;
  }
  function m17LiveTolerance(){var el=q('m17LiveTolerance'),v=el?Number(String(el.value||'').replace(/,/g,'')):0.50;if(!isFinite(v)||v<=0)v=0.50;return Math.max(0.01,v);}
  function m17LiveStatus(dist){if(!isFinite(dist))return {text:'وضعیت: منتظر موقعیت GPS…',cls:'bad',ready:false};var tol=m17LiveTolerance();if(dist<=tol)return {text:'وضعیت: 🎯 داخل تلرانس — آماده ثبت',cls:'ok',ready:true};if(dist<=tol*3)return {text:'وضعیت: نزدیک هدف — ادامه بده',cls:'warn',ready:false};return {text:'وضعیت: خارج از تلرانس — به سمت هدف حرکت کن',cls:'bad',ready:false};}
  function m17LiveGuidance(de,dn,dist){if(!isFinite(dist))return 'حرکت بعدی: منتظر موقعیت GPS…';var tol=m17LiveTolerance();if(dist<=tol)return '🎯 رسیدی؛ نقطه آماده ثبت است.';var parts=[];if(Math.abs(dn)>0.01)parts.push((dn>=0?'شمال':'جنوب')+' '+Math.abs(dn).toFixed(2)+' m');if(Math.abs(de)>0.01)parts.push((de>=0?'شرق':'غرب')+' '+Math.abs(de).toFixed(2)+' m');return parts.length?'حرکت بعدی: '+parts.join('  |  '):'حرکت بعدی: کمتر از ۰٫۰۱ متر';}
  function m17LiveUpdateFinishButton(ready){var b=q('m17LiveFinish');if(b){b.disabled=!ready;b.title=ready?'نقطه داخل تلرانس است و آماده ثبت است.':'برای ثبت، ابتدا داخل تلرانس برس.';}}
  function m17LiveUpdatePosition(pos){if(!m17LiveTarget)return;m17LiveUser={lat:Number(pos.coords.latitude),lng:Number(pos.coords.longitude)};var targetU=wgs84ToUTM(m17LiveTarget.lat,m17LiveTarget.lng),userU=wgs84ToUTM(m17LiveUser.lat,m17LiveUser.lng);var de=targetU.x-userU.x,dn=targetU.y-userU.y,dist=Math.hypot(de,dn),acc=Number(pos.coords.accuracy),az=m17LiveGridAzimuth(de,dn),st=m17LiveStatus(dist);m17LiveSetText('m17LiveDE',m17FormatSigned(de));m17LiveSetText('m17LiveDN',m17FormatSigned(dn));m17LiveSetText('m17LiveAzimuth',isFinite(az)?az.toFixed(2):'—');m17LiveSetText('m17LiveDist',isFinite(dist)?dist.toFixed(2):'—');m17LiveSetText('m17LiveDirection',m17LiveDirection(de,dn));m17LiveSetText('m17LiveStatus',st.text);m17LiveSetText('m17LiveGuidance',m17LiveGuidance(de,dn,dist));m17LiveSetText('m17LiveAccuracy','Accuracy GPS: '+(isFinite(acc)?acc.toFixed(1)+' m':'—'));var se=q('m17LiveStatus');if(se){se.classList.remove('on','ok','warn','bad');se.classList.add(st.cls);}m17LiveUpdateFinishButton(st.ready);m17LiveSetText('m17LiveGpsState','● GPS LIVE');m17LiveUpdateMap();}
  function m17LiveBindTolerance(){var el=q('m17LiveTolerance');if(el&&!el.dataset.bound){el.dataset.bound='1';el.addEventListener('input',function(){var d=q('m17LiveDist'),dist=d?Number(String(d.textContent||'').replace(/−/g,'-')):NaN;if(!isFinite(dist))return;var de=q('m17LiveDE'),dn=q('m17LiveDN'),deN=de?Number(String(de.textContent||'').replace(/−/g,'-')):0,dnN=dn?Number(String(dn.textContent||'').replace(/−/g,'-')):0,st=m17LiveStatus(dist);m17LiveSetText('m17LiveStatus',st.text);m17LiveSetText('m17LiveGuidance',m17LiveGuidance(deN,dnN,dist));var se=q('m17LiveStatus');if(se){se.classList.remove('on','ok','warn','bad');se.classList.add(st.cls);}m17LiveUpdateFinishButton(st.ready);});}}
  var stake3LiveMethod='utm';

  function stake3StartLive(){
    var lat,lng;
    if(stake3LiveMethod==='utm'){
      var x=Number(String(q('stake3X')?q('stake3X').value:'').replace(/,/g,'')),y=Number(String(q('stake3Y')?q('stake3Y').value:'').replace(/,/g,'')),z=Number(String(q('stake3Zone')?q('stake3Zone').value:'').replace(/,/g,''));
      if(!isFinite(x)||!isFinite(y)||!isFinite(z)||z<1||z>60){showToast('X / Y / Zone را صحیح وارد کن');return false;}
      var here=wgs84ToUTM(state.lat,state.lng),conv=m17UtmToWgs84(x,y,z,here.hemisphere==='N');lat=conv.lat;lng=conv.lng;
    }else{

      lat=Number(String(q('stake3Lat')?q('stake3Lat').value:'').replace(/,/g,''));
      if(!isFinite(lat)||!isFinite(lng)||lat<-90||lat>90||lng<-180||lng>180){showToast('طول و عرض جغرافیایی را صحیح وارد کن');return false;}

  function m17LiveStartGPS(){

    if(m17LiveWatchId!==null){try{navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(m17LiveWatchId);}catch(_){ }m17LiveWatchId=null;}
    m17LiveSetText('m17LiveGpsState','GPS …');

  }
  function m17LiveStopGPS(){if(m17LiveWatchId!==null){try{navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(m17LiveWatchId);}catch(_){ }m17LiveWatchId=null;}}
  function m17LiveOpen(target,label){
    m17LiveTarget={lat:Number(target.lat),lng:Number(target.lng)};m17LiveTargetLabel=String(label||('P'+(state.stakePoints.length+1)));m17LiveUser=null;m17LiveTargetIndex=state.stakePoints.length;

    m17LiveSetText('m17LiveStatus','وضعیت: منتظر موقعیت GPS…');m17LiveSetText('m17LiveGuidance','حرکت بعدی: منتظر موقعیت GPS…');var se=q('m17LiveStatus');if(se)se.classList.remove('on','ok','warn','bad');m17LiveUpdateFinishButton(false);
    m.classList.add('show');m.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
    if(mapEl)mapEl.classList.add('m17-live-active');
    state.lat=m17LiveTarget.lat;state.lng=m17LiveTarget.lng;state.zoom=15;renderSoon();m17LiveUpdateMap();m17LiveStartGPS();
  }
  function m17LiveFinish(){

  function showCoordAtLatLng(lat,lng){

    state.tap={lat:ll.lat,lng:ll.lng};
    var utm=wgs84ToUTM(ll.lat,ll.lng);
    var latLine=q('m17LatLine'),lngLine=q('m17LngLine'),utmLine=q('m17UtmLine'),xLine=q('m17XLine'),yLine=q('m17YLine');
    if(latLine)latLine.textContent='عرض جغ: '+ll.lat.toFixed(7);

    if(xLine)xLine.textContent='X: '+utm.x.toFixed(2)+' m';

  function showCoord(e){

  function showGpsPrompt(){
    var p=q('m17GpsPrompt');if(p)p.classList.add('show');
  }
  function hideGpsPrompt(){
    var p=q('m17GpsPrompt');if(p)p.classList.remove('show');
  }
  function useLocation(lat,lng){
    if(!Number.isFinite(Number(lat))||!Number.isFinite(Number(lng)))return;
    state.lat=Number(lat);state.lng=Number(lng);
    state.userLocation={lat:Number(lat),lng:Number(lng)};
    showCoordAtLatLng(Number(lat),Number(lng));
    renderSoon();
    showToast('موقعیت شما پیدا شد ✓');
  }
  function requestBrowserGPS(){
    if(!navigator.geolocation){showGpsPrompt();return;}
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function(pos){
      useLocation(pos.coords.latitude,pos.coords.longitude);
      hideGpsPrompt();
    },function(){
      showGpsPrompt();
    }, {enableHighAccuracy:true,timeout:12000,maximumAge:0});
  }
  function nativeLocationEnabled(){
    try{
      if(window.AndroidBridge && typeof window.AndroidBridge.isLocationEnabled==='function')
        return !!window.AndroidBridge.isLocationEnabled();
    }catch(_){ }
    return true;
  }
  function requestGPS(){
    /* V191: Android app first handles permission, then the user can manually turn GPS on. */
    try{
      if(window.AndroidBridge && typeof window.AndroidBridge.requestLocationPermission==='function'){
        window.AndroidBridge.requestLocationPermission();
        return;
      }
    }catch(_){ }
    if(navigator.geolocation){
      requestBrowserGPS();
      return;
    }
    showGpsPrompt();
  }
  function openGpsSettings(){
    /* V191: open the real Android Location settings so the user can switch GPS on manually. */
    try{
      if(window.AndroidBridge && typeof window.AndroidBridge.openLocationSettings==='function'){
        hideGpsPrompt();
        window.AndroidBridge.openLocationSettings();
        return;
      }
    }catch(_){ }
    hideGpsPrompt();
    try{
      if(navigator.geolocation) requestBrowserGPS();
      else showGpsPrompt();
    }catch(_){showGpsPrompt();}
  }
  window.onNativeLocationPermission=function(granted){
    try{
      if(!granted){
        hideGpsPrompt();
        showToast('اجازه دسترسی به موقعیت مکانی داده نشد');
        return;
      }
      if(!nativeLocationEnabled()){
        showGpsPrompt();
        showToast('GPS خاموش است؛ آن را از تنظیمات گوشی روشن کنید');
        return;
      }
      hideGpsPrompt();
      requestBrowserGPS();
    }catch(_){ }
  };

    if(state.mapLayer==='relief') return 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Shaded_Relief/MapServer/tile/'+z+'/'+y+'/'+tx;
    if(state.mapLayer==='humanitarian') return 'https://tile.openstreetmap.fr/hot/'+z+'/'+tx+'/'+y+'.png';
    if(state.mapLayer==='gray') return 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Base/MapServer/tile/'+z+'/'+y+'/'+tx;
    if(state.mapLayer==='satellite') return 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/'+z+'/'+y+'/'+tx;

  function latLngFromScreen(x,y){var rect=mapEl.getBoundingClientRect(),w=Math.max(1,rect.width),h=Math.max(1,rect.height),center=worldXY(state.lat,state.lng,state.zoom),n=Math.pow(2,state.zoom)*TILE,wx=center.x+(x-w/2),wy=center.y+(y-h/2),lng=wx/n*360-180,merc=1-2*wy/n,lat=180/Math.PI*Math.atan(Math.sinh(Math.PI*merc));return {lat:clampLat(lat),lng:wrapLng(lng)};}

  function renderMiladTowerMarker(){
    var el=q('m17MiladTower');
    if(!el||!mapEl)return;
    var rect=mapEl.getBoundingClientRect(),w=Math.max(1,rect.width),h=Math.max(1,rect.height);
    var c=worldXY(state.lat,state.lng,state.zoom),p=worldXY(MILAD_TOWER_LAT,MILAD_TOWER_LNG,state.zoom);
    var n=Math.pow(2,state.zoom)*TILE,dx=p.x-c.x;
    if(dx>n/2)dx-=n; else if(dx<-n/2)dx+=n;
    var left=w/2+dx,top=h/2+(p.y-c.y);
    if(left<-80||left>w+80||top<-80||top>h+80){el.style.display='none';return;}
    el.style.left=Math.round(left)+'px';
    el.style.top=Math.round(top)+'px';
    el.style.display='block';
  }
  function renderUserLocationMarker(){
    var el=q('m17UserLocation');
    if(!el||!mapEl)return;
    if(!state.userLocation){el.style.display='none';return;}
    var rect=mapEl.getBoundingClientRect(),w=Math.max(1,rect.width),h=Math.max(1,rect.height);
    var c=worldXY(state.lat,state.lng,state.zoom),p=worldXY(state.userLocation.lat,state.userLocation.lng,state.zoom);
    var n=Math.pow(2,state.zoom)*TILE,dx=p.x-c.x;
    if(dx>n/2)dx-=n; else if(dx<-n/2)dx+=n;
    var left=w/2+dx,top=h/2+(p.y-c.y);
    if(left<-40||left>w+40||top<-40||top>h+40){el.style.display='none';return;}
    el.style.left=Math.round(left)+'px';el.style.top=Math.round(top)+'px';el.style.display='block';
  }

  window.m17RouteData=window.m17RouteData||null;

  function render(){

        img.style.left=Math.round(w/2+(tx*TILE-c.x))+'px';

    var px=center.x+(cx-w/2),py=center.y+(cy-h/2);

  function pointerDown(e){

    mapEl.setPointerCapture&&mapEl.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    if(!state.p1){state.p1={id:e.pointerId,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};return;}
    if(!state.p2){state.p2={id:e.pointerId,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};return;}

  function m17Esc(v){return String(v==null?'':v).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g,'&apos;');}
  function m17VisibleShapes(){
    var mode=state.drawMode,base=[];

  function m17AllVertices(){

    }

  }
  function m17FirstLine(){

  function m17CurrentArea(){

  function m17TapIsStake(){

  function m17BuildKml(){
    var k=['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>','<kml xmlns="http://www.opengis.net/kml/2.2"><Document><name>MiladGeo Menu 17</name>'];
    var verts=m17AllVertices(),shapes=m17VisibleShapes(),i,sh,j,coords;
    for(i=0;i<shapes.length;i++){
      sh=shapes[i];

        k.push('<Placemark><name>Point '+(i+1)+'</name><Point><coordinates>'+sh.points[0].lng+','+sh.points[0].lat+',0</coordinates></Point></Placemark>');

  function m17DownloadBlob(blob,name){
    /* V183 FIX: Menu 17 is a separate IIFE. The old code called
       directSaveBlob() directly, but that helper is private to the main
       runtime, causing a ReferenceError and an unreliable <a download> fallback. */
    try{
      if(window.AndroidBridge&&typeof window.AndroidBridge.saveFile==='function'&&typeof window.miladgeoDirectSaveBlob==='function'){
        return window.miladgeoDirectSaveBlob(name,blob);
      }
      if(window.miladgeoNative&&typeof window.miladgeoNative.saveFile==='function'&&typeof window.miladgeoDirectSaveBlob==='function'){
        return window.miladgeoDirectSaveBlob(name,blob);
      }
      if(typeof window.miladgeoExportBlob==='function'){
        return window.miladgeoExportBlob(name,blob);
      }
    }catch(e){
      console.error('M17 export bridge failed',e);
    }
    try{
      var a=document.createElement('a'),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.href=url;a.download=name;a.rel='noopener';a.style.display='none';
      document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();
      setTimeout(function(){try{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);}catch(_){}
        try{a.remove();}catch(_){}
      },10000);
      return true;
    }catch(e){return false;}
  }
  function m17ParseKmlText(text){
    var parser=new DOMParser(),xml=parser.parseFromString(text,'application/xml');
    if(xml.getElementsByTagName('parsererror').length)throw new Error('فرمت KML معتبر نیست');
    var out=[];

    function coordsFrom(el){
      var c=directText(el,'coordinates');
      if(!c)return [];

    }
    var placemarks=xml.getElementsByTagName('Placemark'),i,j,pm,lines,polys,pts,name,cs;
    for(i=0;i<placemarks.length;i++){
      pm=placemarks[i]; name=directText(pm,'name');
      pts=pm.getElementsByTagName('Point');
      for(j=0;j<pts.length;j++){cs=coordsFrom(pts[j]);if(cs.length)out.push({type:'point',points:[cs[0]],name:name||''});}
      lines=pm.getElementsByTagName('LineString');
      for(j=0;j<lines.length;j++){cs=coordsFrom(lines[j]);if(cs.length>=2)out.push({type:'line',points:cs,name:name||''});}
      polys=pm.getElementsByTagName('Polygon');
      for(j=0;j<polys.length;j++){
        var outer=polys[j].getElementsByTagName('outerBoundaryIs')[0]||polys[j];
        var rings=outer.getElementsByTagName('LinearRing');

          out.push({type:'line',points:cs,name:name||''});
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
  function m17ApplyImportedShapes(shapes){

    for(var i=0;i<shapes.length;i++){
      var sh=shapes[i];
      state.drawShapes.push({type:sh.type==='point'?'point':'line',points:sh.points.map(function(p){return {lat:p.lat,lng:p.lng};}),measureType:sh.measureType||'line',imported:true,name:sh.name||''});
    }

    var bs=document.querySelectorAll('#m17DrawToolbar button[data-mode]');for(var b=0;b<bs.length;b++)bs[b].classList.toggle('active',bs[b].getAttribute('data-mode')===state.drawMode);

  function m17ParseGeoJSONText(text){

    function pos(c){if(!Array.isArray(c)||c.length<2)return null;var lng=Number(c[0]),lat=Number(c[1]);return isFinite(lat)&&isFinite(lng)&&Math.abs(lat)<=90&&Math.abs(lng)<=180?{lat:lat,lng:lng}:null;}

  function m17ParseGpxText(text){
    var xml=new DOMParser().parseFromString(text,'application/xml');if(xml.getElementsByTagName('parsererror').length)throw new Error('ساختار GPX معتبر نیست');
    var out=[];function points(parent,tag){var ns=parent.getElementsByTagName(tag),a=[];for(var i=0;i<ns.length;i++){var lat=Number(ns[i].getAttribute('lat')),lng=Number(ns[i].getAttribute('lon'));if(isFinite(lat)&&isFinite(lng)&&Math.abs(lat)<=90&&Math.abs(lng)<=180)a.push({lat:lat,lng:lng});}return a;}

  function m17ParseShapefile(buffer){

    function xy(off){var x=dv.getFloat64(off,true),y=dv.getFloat64(off+8,true);if(!isFinite(x)||!isFinite(y)||Math.abs(y)>90||Math.abs(x)>180) return null;return {lat:y,lng:x};}

  function m17ImportFile(file){

    function readZip(){var reader=new FileReader();reader.onerror=function(){showToast('خواندن فایل ZIP ناموفق بود');};reader.onload=function(e){m17LoadJsZip(function(JSZip){if(!JSZip){showToast('موتور ZIP آفلاین بارگذاری نشد؛ فایل اصلی تغییری نکرد.');return;}JSZip.loadAsync(e.target.result).then(function(zip){var names=Object.keys(zip.files).filter(function(n){return !zip.files[n].dir;});var kml=names.find(function(n){return /\.kml$/i.test(n);});var shp=names.find(function(n){return /\.shp$/i.test(n);});if(/\.kmz$/i.test(name)){if(!kml)throw new Error('فایل KML داخل KMZ پیدا نشد');return zip.files[kml].async('string').then(function(t){m17ApplyImportedShapes(m17ParseKmlText(t));});}if(shp){var base=shp.replace(/\.shp$/i,'');var shx=names.some(function(n){return n.toLowerCase()=== (base+'.shx').toLowerCase();}),dbf=names.some(function(n){return n.toLowerCase()===(base+'.dbf').toLowerCase();});if(!shx||!dbf)throw new Error('برای Shapefile باید فایل‌های SHP، SHX و DBF داخل ZIP باشند');var prj=names.find(function(n){return n.toLowerCase()===(base+'.prj').toLowerCase();});var get=zip.files[shp].async('arraybuffer');return Promise.all([get,prj?zip.files[prj].async('string'):Promise.resolve('')]).then(function(vals){if(vals[1]&&!/4326|WGS.?84|WGS_1984/i.test(vals[1]))throw new Error('این Shapefile در مختصات جغرافیایی WGS84 نیست؛ ابتدا آن را به EPSG:4326 تبدیل کنید');m17ApplyImportedShapes(m17ParseShapefile(vals[0]));});}if(kml)return zip.files[kml].async('string').then(function(t){m17ApplyImportedShapes(m17ParseKmlText(t));});throw new Error('داخل ZIP فایل SHP یا KML پیدا نشد');}).catch(function(err){showToast('خطا در بازکردن فایل: '+(err.message||err));});});};reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);}

  function m17DownloadKml(){
    var ok=m17DownloadBlob(new Blob([m17BuildKml()],{type:'application/vnd.google-earth.kml+xml;charset=utf-8'}),'miladgeo-menu17.kml');
    if(!ok&&window.m17Toast)window.m17Toast('دانلود KML انجام نشد');
  }
  function m17ExportFeatures(){
    var features=[],shapes=m17VisibleShapes(),i,sh,coords,geom,name;
    for(i=0;i<shapes.length;i++){
      sh=shapes[i]; if(!sh.points||!sh.points.length)continue;
      name=sh.name||((sh.type==='point'?'Point ':'Shape ')+(i+1));
      if(sh.type==='point')geom={type:'Point',coordinates:[Number(sh.points[0].lng),Number(sh.points[0].lat)]};
      else if(sh.points.length>=2){
        coords=sh.points.map(function(p){return [Number(p.lng),Number(p.lat)];});
        if(sh.measureType==='area'&&coords.length>=3){
          if(coords[0][0]!==coords[coords.length-1][0]||coords[0][1]!==coords[coords.length-1][1])coords.push(coords[0].slice());
          geom={type:'Polygon',coordinates:[coords]};
        }else geom={type:'LineString',coordinates:coords};
      }else continue;
      features.push({type:'Feature',properties:{name:name,source:'MiladGeo Menu 17'},geometry:geom});
    }
    if(state.tap&&!m17TapIsStake())features.push({type:'Feature',properties:{name:'Selected Point',source:'MiladGeo Menu 17'},geometry:{type:'Point',coordinates:[Number(state.tap.lng),Number(state.tap.lat)]}});
    return {type:'FeatureCollection',name:'MiladGeo Menu 17',features:features};
  }
  function m17DownloadGeoJSON(){
    var data=m17ExportFeatures();
    if(!data.features.length){showToast('برای خروجی، ابتدا نقطه یا ترسیم اضافه کنید');return;}
    var text=JSON.stringify(data,null,2);
    var ok=m17DownloadBlob(new Blob([text],{type:'application/geo+json;charset=utf-8'}),'miladgeo-menu17.geojson');
    if(!ok)showToast('دانلود GeoJSON انجام نشد');
  }
  function m17DownloadGpx(){
    var features=m17ExportFeatures().features,xml=['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>','<gpx version="1.1" creator="MiladGeo Menu 17" xmlns="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1">'];
    function esc(v){return String(v==null?'':v).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g,'&apos;');}
    var i,f,g,c,j;
    for(i=0;i<features.length;i++){
      f=features[i];g=f.geometry;c=g&&g.coordinates;if(!g||!c)continue;
      if(g.type==='Point')xml.push('<wpt lat="'+c[1]+'" lon="'+c[0]+'"><name>'+esc(f.properties.name)+'</name></wpt>');
      else if(g.type==='LineString'&&c.length>=2){xml.push('<trk><name>'+esc(f.properties.name)+'</name><trkseg>');for(j=0;j<c.length;j++)xml.push('<trkpt lat="'+c[j][1]+'" lon="'+c[j][0]+'"></trkpt>');xml.push('</trkseg></trk>');}
      else if(g.type==='Polygon'&&c[0]&&c[0].length>=4){xml.push('<trk><name>'+esc(f.properties.name)+'</name><trkseg>');for(j=0;j<c[0].length;j++)xml.push('<trkpt lat="'+c[0][j][1]+'" lon="'+c[0][j][0]+'"></trkpt>');xml.push('</trkseg></trk>');}
    }
    xml.push('</gpx>');
    if(!features.length){showToast('برای خروجی، ابتدا نقطه یا ترسیم اضافه کنید');return;}
    var ok=m17DownloadBlob(new Blob([xml.join('\n')],{type:'application/gpx+xml;charset=utf-8'}),'miladgeo-menu17.gpx');
    if(!ok)showToast('دانلود GPX انجام نشد');
  }
  /* V228 — Load the bundled offline JSZip engine first. KMZ and zipped
     Shapefile imports must work without a network connection in the Android APK. */
  function m17LoadJsZip(cb){
    if(window.JSZip&&typeof window.JSZip.loadAsync==='function'){cb(window.JSZip);return;}
    window.__m17ZipWaiters=window.__m17ZipWaiters||[];
    window.__m17ZipWaiters.push(cb);
    if(window.__m17ZipLoading)return;
    window.__m17ZipLoading=true;
    var urls=['./jszip.min.js','file:///android_asset/jszip.min.js','https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1/jszip.min.js'],i=0;
    function finish(lib){window.__m17ZipLoading=false;var q=window.__m17ZipWaiters||[];window.__m17ZipWaiters=[];q.forEach(function(fn){try{fn(lib||null);}catch(e){console.error('M17 JSZip callback',e);}});}
    function next(){
      if(window.JSZip&&typeof window.JSZip.loadAsync==='function'){finish(window.JSZip);return;}
      if(i>=urls.length){finish(null);return;}
      var src=urls[i++],sc=document.createElement('script');sc.src=src;sc.async=true;
      sc.onload=function(){if(window.JSZip&&typeof window.JSZip.loadAsync==='function')finish(window.JSZip);else next();};
      sc.onerror=next;document.head.appendChild(sc);
    }
    next();
  }
  function m17DownloadKmz(){
    m17LoadJsZip(function(JSZip){
      if(!JSZip){alert('برای ساخت KMZ اتصال اینترنت لازم است.');return;}
      var zip=new JSZip();zip.file('doc.kml',m17BuildKml());
      zip.generateAsync({type:'blob',mimeType:'application/vnd.google-earth.kmz'}).then(function(blob){m17DownloadBlob(blob,'miladgeo-menu17.kmz');});
    });
  }
  function m17CsvEscape(v){var s=String(v==null?'':v);return '"'+s.replace(/"/g,'""')+'"';}
  function m17DownloadCsv(){
    var rows=[['Point','Type','Vertex','Latitude','Longitude','UTM Zone','Hemisphere','X (m)','Y (m)']],verts=m17AllVertices(),i,v,u;
    for(i=0;i<verts.length;i++){v=verts[i];u=wgs84ToUTM(v.lat,v.lng);rows.push([v.index,v.shape,v.vertex,v.lat.toFixed(7),v.lng.toFixed(7),u.zone,u.hemisphere,u.x.toFixed(2),u.y.toFixed(2)]);}
    if(state.tap&&!m17TapIsStake()){u=wgs84ToUTM(state.tap.lat,state.tap.lng);rows.push(['Selected','point','1',state.tap.lat.toFixed(7),state.tap.lng.toFixed(7),u.zone,u.hemisphere,u.x.toFixed(2),u.y.toFixed(2)]);}
    var area=m17CurrentArea();rows.push([]);rows.push(['Area (m²)',area.toFixed(2)]);var csv='\uFEFF'+rows.map(function(r){return r.map(m17CsvEscape).join(',');}).join('\r\n');
    m17DownloadBlob(new Blob([csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}),'miladgeo-menu17.csv');
  }
  function m17DownloadTxt(){
    var verts=m17AllVertices(),area=m17CurrentArea(),arr=[];
    arr.push('MiladGeo - Menu 17');
    arr.push('==============================');
    arr.push('تعداد رئوس: '+verts.length);
    arr.push('مساحت: '+area.toFixed(2)+' مترمربع');
    arr.push('');
    arr.push('مختصات نقاط:');
    arr.push('------------------------------');
    var i,v,u;
    for(i=0;i<verts.length;i++){
      v=verts[i];u=wgs84ToUTM(v.lat,v.lng);
      arr.push('P'+v.index+'-'+v.vertex+' | Lat: '+v.lat.toFixed(7)+' | Lon: '+v.lng.toFixed(7)+' | UTM '+u.zone+u.hemisphere+' | X: '+u.x.toFixed(2)+' | Y: '+u.y.toFixed(2));
    }
    if(state.tap&&!m17TapIsStake()){
      u=wgs84ToUTM(state.tap.lat,state.tap.lng);
      arr.push('Selected | Lat: '+state.tap.lat.toFixed(7)+' | Lon: '+state.tap.lng.toFixed(7)+' | UTM '+u.zone+u.hemisphere+' | X: '+u.x.toFixed(2)+' | Y: '+u.y.toFixed(2));
    }
