    m17DownloadBlob(new Blob([txt],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'}),'miladgeo-menu17.txt');
  }
  function m17CopyCoords(){
    var verts=m17AllVertices(),arr=[],i,u,v;
    for(i=0;i<verts.length;i++){v=verts[i];u=wgs84ToUTM(v.lat,v.lng);arr.push('P'+v.index+'-'+v.vertex+' | Lat: '+v.lat.toFixed(7)+' | Lon: '+v.lng.toFixed(7)+' | UTM '+u.zone+u.hemisphere+' | X: '+u.x.toFixed(2)+' | Y: '+u.y.toFixed(2));}
    if(state.tap){u=wgs84ToUTM(state.tap.lat,state.tap.lng);arr.push('Selected | Lat: '+state.tap.lat.toFixed(7)+' | Lon: '+state.tap.lng.toFixed(7)+' | UTM '+u.zone+u.hemisphere+' | X: '+u.x.toFixed(2)+' | Y: '+u.y.toFixed(2));}
    var txt=arr.join('\n')||'مختصاتی برای کپی وجود ندارد.';
    if(navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText)navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(function(){alert('مختصات کپی شد.');},function(){window.prompt('کپی کنید:',txt);});else window.prompt('کپی کنید:',txt);
  }
  function m17EarthExportInfo(){
    var ll=state.tap||{lat:Number(state.lat)||0,lng:Number(state.lng)||0};
    var u=wgs84ToUTM(Number(ll.lat),Number(ll.lng));
    var area=m17CurrentArea();
    return {
      lat:Number(ll.lat), lng:Number(ll.lng), x:u.x, y:u.y,
      zone:u.zone, hemisphere:u.hemisphere, area:area
    };
  }
  function m17DownloadGoogleEarthJpg(){
    /* v178: export the current Google Earth satellite composition + drawings as JPG. */
    if(!mapEl||!tilesEl){showToast('نقشه ماهواره‌ای آماده نیست');return false;}
    var rect=mapEl.getBoundingClientRect(),w=Math.max(1,Math.round(rect.width)),h=Math.max(1,Math.round(rect.height));
    var scale=Math.min(2,1600/w),W=Math.max(1,Math.round(w*scale)),H=Math.max(1,Math.round(h*scale));
    var imgs=tilesEl.querySelectorAll('img');
    if(!imgs.length){showToast('تصویر ماهواره‌ای هنوز بارگذاری نشده است');return false;}
    var canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=W;canvas.height=H;
    var ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    var earthInfo=m17EarthExportInfo();
    var loaded=[],i;
    for(i=0;i<imgs.length;i++){
      (function(im){
        var src=im.currentSrc||im.src;
        loaded.push(new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
          var x=new Image();x.crossOrigin='anonymous';x.onload=function(){resolve({im:x,left:Number(im.offsetLeft)||0,top:Number(im.offsetTop)||0,w:Number(im.offsetWidth)||256,h:Number(im.offsetHeight)||256});};x.onerror=function(){reject(new Error('TILE_CORS'));};x.src=src;
        }));
      })(imgs[i]);
    }
    Promise.all(loaded).then(function(list){
      list.forEach(function(o){ctx.drawImage(o.im,o.left*scale,o.top*scale,o.w*scale,o.h*scale);});
      /* Draw the live SVG layer on top of the satellite image. */
      var svg=q('m17DrawSvg');
      if(svg){
        var clone=svg.cloneNode(true);clone.setAttribute('width',w);clone.setAttribute('height',h);
        var ser=new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(clone);
        var blob=new Blob([ser],{type:'image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8'}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),ov=new Image();
        ov.onload=function(){ctx.drawImage(ov,0,0,W,H);URL.revokeObjectURL(url);finish();};
        ov.onerror=function(){URL.revokeObjectURL(url);finish();};ov.src=url;
      }else finish();
      function finish(){
        /* v179: print the same coordinate/UTM/area information that is visible above the live map. */
        try{
          /* v182: اطلاعات خروجی را ردیفی و کاملاً جدا می‌نویسیم تا RTL فارسی
             هیچ‌وقت با اعداد LTR قاطی نشود. ترتیب: X/Y، طول/عرض، Zone، مساحت. */
          var boxH=Math.max(220,Math.round(172*scale));
          var pad=Math.max(12,Math.round(14*scale));
          var fs=Math.max(15,Math.round(18*scale));
          var line=Math.max(25,Math.round(27*scale));
          var xLabelX=Math.round(W*0.06), xValueX=Math.round(W*0.48);
          var geoLabelX=W-pad, geoValueX=Math.round(W*0.52);
          var y0=pad+14*scale;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.76)';
          ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,boxH);
          ctx.textBaseline='middle';
          ctx.font='900 '+fs+'px Arial, Tahoma, sans-serif';
          ctx.fillStyle='#fff';

          /* X / Y — هر ردیف مستقل و عددها کاملاً LTR */
          ctx.direction='ltr';
          ctx.textAlign='left';
          ctx.fillText('X: '+earthInfo.x.toFixed(2)+' m',xLabelX,y0);
          ctx.fillText('Y: '+earthInfo.y.toFixed(2)+' m',xLabelX,y0+line);

          /* طول و عرض جغرافیایی — برچسب فارسی جدا از عدد */
          ctx.direction='rtl';
          ctx.textAlign='right';
          ctx.fillText('طول جغ:',geoLabelX,y0+line*2);
          ctx.fillText('عرض جغ:',geoLabelX,y0+line*3);
          ctx.direction='ltr';
          ctx.textAlign='right';
          ctx.fillText(earthInfo.lng.toFixed(7)+'°',geoValueX,y0+line*2);
          ctx.fillText(earthInfo.lat.toFixed(7)+'°',geoValueX,y0+line*3);

          /* Zone */
          ctx.direction='ltr';
          ctx.textAlign='center';
          ctx.fillText('UTM Zone '+earthInfo.zone+earthInfo.hemisphere,W/2,y0+line*4+2);

          /* Area */
          ctx.fillStyle='#b7f57b';
          ctx.textAlign='center';
          ctx.fillText(earthInfo.area.toFixed(2)+' m²',W/2,y0+line*5+2);          ctx.restore();
        }catch(e){console.warn('M17 JPG info',e);}
        try{
          canvas.toBlob(function(blob){
            if(!blob){showToast('ساخت JPG ناموفق بود');return;}
            m17DownloadBlob(blob,'miladgeo-google-earth.jpg');
            showToast('✓ تصویر Google Earth به صورت JPG آماده شد');
          },'image/jpeg',0.92);
        }catch(e){console.error('M17 JPG',e);showToast('⚠️ مرورگر اجازه ساخت JPG از نقشه ماهواره‌ای را نداد');}
      }
    }).catch(function(err){console.error('M17 JPG tiles',err);showToast('⚠️ ساخت JPG نقشه ماهواره‌ای توسط مرورگر مسدود شد');});
    return false;
  }
  function m17PrintHtml(html, fallbackTitle){
    /* V185: On Android use the native PrintManager bridge instead of window.open().
       This keeps the print/PDF flow inside the app, so Android BACK returns to MiladGeo. */
    try{
      if(window.AndroidBridge && typeof window.AndroidBridge.printHtml==='function'){
        window.AndroidBridge.printHtml(String(html));
        return true;
      }
      if(window.miladgeoNative && typeof window.miladgeoNative.printHtml==='function'){
        window.miladgeoNative.printHtml(String(html));
        return true;
      }
    }catch(e){console.error('M17 native print',e);}
    try{
      var w=window.open('','_blank');
      if(!w){alert('پنجره PDF توسط مرورگر مسدود شده است.');return false;}
      w.document.open();w.document.write(html);w.document.close();
      setTimeout(function(){try{w.focus();w.print();}catch(e){}},700);
      return true;
    }catch(e){console.error('M17 browser print',e);return false;}
  }
  /* Public bridge for other MiladGeo menus: reuse the exact Menu 17 print/PDF delivery path. */
  window.miladgeoM17PrintHtml=function(html,title){return m17PrintHtml(html,title);};
  function m17PrintGoogleEarth(){
    /* v173: A4-fit satellite PDF with the current drawing overlay on top of the map. */
    if(!mapEl||!tilesEl){showToast('نقشه ماهواره‌ای آماده نیست');return false;}
    var mapW=Math.max(1,mapEl.clientWidth),mapH=Math.max(1,mapEl.clientHeight);
    var pageWpx=718, pageHpx=1032; /* A4 printable area ~= 190 x 273 mm at 96 dpi */
    var scale=Math.min(1,pageWpx/mapW,pageHpx/mapH);
    var outW=Math.max(1,Math.round(mapW*scale)),outH=Math.max(1,Math.round(mapH*scale));
    var imgs=tilesEl.querySelectorAll('img'),htmlImgs='';
    for(var i=0;i<imgs.length;i++){
      var im=imgs[i],left=Number(im.offsetLeft)||0,top=Number(im.offsetTop)||0;
      var iw=Number(im.offsetWidth)||256,ih=Number(im.offsetHeight)||256;
      htmlImgs+='<img src="'+m17Esc(im.currentSrc||im.src)+'" style="position:absolute;left:'+left+'px;top:'+top+'px;width:'+iw+'px;height:'+ih+'px;max-width:none;display:block" />';
    }
    if(!htmlImgs){showToast('تصویر ماهواره‌ای هنوز بارگذاری نشده است');return false;}

    /* Copy the live SVG drawing layer so every line / area / point is printed on the satellite image. */
    var liveSvg=q('m17DrawSvg'),svgHtml=liveSvg?liveSvg.outerHTML:'';
    var earthInfo=m17EarthExportInfo();
    var earthInfoHtml='<div class="print-coord-box">'+
      '<div class="pc-row"><span>طول جغ: '+earthInfo.lng.toFixed(7)+'</span><span>X: '+earthInfo.x.toFixed(2)+' m</span></div>'+
      '<div class="pc-row"><span>عرض جغ: '+earthInfo.lat.toFixed(7)+'</span><span>Y: '+earthInfo.y.toFixed(2)+' m</span></div>'+
      '<div class="pc-utm">UTM Zone '+earthInfo.zone+earthInfo.hemisphere+'</div>'+
      '<div class="pc-area">مساحت: '+earthInfo.area.toFixed(2)+' مترمربع</div>'+
      '</div>';
    var tapHtml='';
    if(state.tap){
      try{
        var tpx=0,tpy=0,r=mapEl.getBoundingClientRect(),mw=Math.max(1,r.width),mh=Math.max(1,r.height);
        var c=worldXY(state.tap.lat,state.tap.lng,state.zoom);
        var cc=worldXY(state.lat,state.lng,state.zoom);
        tpx=mw/2+(c.x-cc.x); tpy=mh/2+(c.y-cc.y);
        tapHtml='<div class="print-gps" style="left:'+tpx.toFixed(1)+'px;top:'+tpy.toFixed(1)+'px"><span class="dot"></span><span>GPS</span></div>';
      }catch(_){}
    }

    var html='<!doctype html><html dir="rtl"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>MiladGeo - Google Earth</title><style>'+
      '@page{size:A4 portrait;margin:8mm}'+
      'html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#fff;color:#111}'+
      'body{font-family:Arial,Tahoma,sans-serif;text-align:center;overflow:hidden}'+
      '.title{font-size:17px;font-weight:900;margin:0 0 6px}'+
      '.page{width:190mm;height:273mm;margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}'+
      '.frame{width:'+outW+'px;height:'+outH+'px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;flex:0 0 auto}'+
      '.shot{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:'+mapW+'px;height:'+mapH+'px;transform:scale('+scale+');transform-origin:top left;overflow:hidden;background:#000}'+
      '.shot img{position:absolute!important}'+
      '.shot svg{position:absolute!important;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:20;display:block;overflow:visible;pointer-events:none}'+
      '.shot svg .m17-line{fill:none;stroke:#ffeb3b;stroke-width:4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.7))}'+
      '.shot svg .m17-poly{fill:rgba(255,235,59,.18);stroke:#ffeb3b;stroke-width:4;stroke-linejoin:round;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.7))}'+
      '.shot svg .m17-point{fill:#1976d2;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.7))}'+
      '.shot svg .m17-circle{fill:rgba(255,235,59,.14);stroke:#ffeb3b;stroke-width:4;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.7))}'+
      '.shot svg .m17-point-label{font-size:14px;font-family:Arial,Tahoma,sans-serif;font-weight:900;fill:#fff;paint-order:stroke;stroke:#111;stroke-width:4;stroke-linejoin:round}'+
      '.print-coord-box{position:absolute;z-index:25;left:0;right:0;top:0;padding:8px 12px 9px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.72);color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.35;box-sizing:border-box;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #000}'+
      '.print-coord-box .pc-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;direction:rtl}.print-coord-box .pc-utm{text-align:center;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);margin-top:4px;padding-top:4px}.print-coord-box .pc-area{text-align:center;color:#b7f57b;margin-top:3px}'+
      '.print-gps{position:absolute;z-index:30;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);font-weight:900;font-size:14px;color:#b71c1c;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #fff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;white-space:nowrap}'+
      '.print-back{position:fixed;right:10px;top:10px;z-index:999;padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid #555;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#111;font-weight:900}.print-gps .dot{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:#d32f2f;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.65);display:inline-block}'+
      '@media print{.print-back{display:none!important}body{width:100%;height:auto}.title{margin-bottom:4px}.page{width:190mm;height:273mm;max-width:190mm;max-height:273mm}}'+
      '</style></head><body><div class="title">تصویر ماهواره‌ای Google Earth — MiladGeo</div><div class="page"><div class="frame"><div class="shot">'+htmlImgs+earthInfoHtml+svgHtml+tapHtml+'</div></div></div>'+
      '<button class="print-back" type="button" onclick="history.back()">↩ بازگشت</button></body></html>';

    m17PrintHtml(html,'MiladGeo - Google Earth');
    return false;
  }
  function m17PrintReport(){
    /* v173: A4 survey PDF — always include ALL stored drawing vertices, regardless of the currently selected drawing mode. */
    var reportShapes=state.drawShapes.slice(),area=m17CurrentArea(),rows='',i,v,u,sh,j;
    for(i=0;i<state.stakePoints.length;i++)reportShapes.push({type:'point',points:[state.stakePoints[i]],stakeOut:true});
    var verts=[];
    for(i=0;i<reportShapes.length;i++){
      sh=reportShapes[i];
      if(!sh||!sh.points)continue;
      for(j=0;j<sh.points.length;j++)verts.push({lat:Number(sh.points[j].lat),lng:Number(sh.points[j].lng),shape:sh.type,index:i+1,vertex:j+1});
    }
    /* Also include an unfinished line so the report never loses points touched before pressing Finish. */
    if(state.drawPoints&&state.drawPoints.length){
      for(j=0;j<state.drawPoints.length;j++)verts.push({lat:Number(state.drawPoints[j].lat),lng:Number(state.drawPoints[j].lng),shape:'line',index:reportShapes.length+1,vertex:j+1,live:true});
    }
    for(i=0;i<verts.length;i++){
      v=verts[i];u=wgs84ToUTM(v.lat,v.lng);
      var prevDist='';
      if(i>0){
        var pv=verts[i-1],pu=wgs84ToUTM(pv.lat,pv.lng);
        var ddx=u.x-pu.x,ddy=u.y-pu.y;
        prevDist=Math.sqrt(ddx*ddx+ddy*ddy).toFixed(2);
      }
      rows+='<tr><td>'+m17Esc('P'+(i+1))+'</td><td>'+u.x.toFixed(2)+'</td><td>'+u.y.toFixed(2)+'</td><td>'+u.zone+u.hemisphere+'</td><td>'+v.lng.toFixed(7)+'</td><td>'+v.lat.toFixed(7)+'</td><td>'+prevDist+'</td></tr>';
    }
    var visibleShapes=reportShapes,pts=[],sh;
    for(i=0;i<visibleShapes.length;i++){sh=visibleShapes[i];for(j=0;j<sh.points.length;j++)pts.push(sh.points[j]);}
    if(state.drawPoints&&state.drawPoints.length)for(i=0;i<state.drawPoints.length;i++)pts.push(state.drawPoints[i]);
    if(state.tap&&!m17TapIsStake())pts.push(state.tap);
    var sketchW=900,sketchH=430,pad=55,sketchSvg='';
    if(pts.length){
      var minLat=pts[0].lat,maxLat=pts[0].lat,minLng=pts[0].lng,maxLng=pts[0].lng;
      for(i=1;i<pts.length;i++){minLat=Math.min(minLat,pts[i].lat);maxLat=Math.max(maxLat,pts[i].lat);minLng=Math.min(minLng,pts[i].lng);maxLng=Math.max(maxLng,pts[i].lng);}
      var latSpan=Math.max(maxLat-minLat,0.000001),lngSpan=Math.max(maxLng-minLng,0.000001),usableW=sketchW-2*pad,usableH=sketchH-2*pad;
      var latCos=Math.cos(((minLat+maxLat)/2)*Math.PI/180),adjLng=lngSpan*Math.max(.2,latCos),scale=Math.min(usableW/adjLng,usableH/latSpan),usedW=adjLng*scale,usedH=latSpan*scale,offX=(sketchW-usedW)/2,offY=(sketchH-usedH)/2;

'+stepText(st);setStatus(msg);if(!say(msg))setStatus(msg+' (صدای گوشی در دسترس نیست)');}}

  };
  /* V332: center/zoom the map so the saved topography boundary is actually visible. */

      var minLat=Infinity,maxLat=-Infinity,minLng=Infinity,maxLng=-Infinity;
      for(var i=0;i<poly.length;i++){

      state.lng=(minLng+maxLng)/2;

<script id="menu2-real-dashboard-v275">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  function q(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
  function esc(v){return String(v==null?'':v).replace(/[&<>\"']/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','\"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]})}
  function fmt(v,n){var x=Number(v);return isFinite(x)?x.toFixed(n):'-'}
  function fa(v){return String(v).replace(/\d/g,function(x){return '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'[x]})}
  function data(){try{return typeof window.miladgeoMenu17Snapshot==='function'?window.miladgeoMenu17Snapshot():{points:[],lines:[]}}catch(e){return {points:[],lines:[]}}}
  window.m2SelectSketchMode=function(mode){
    mode=(mode==='line'||mode==='area')?mode:'point';
    window.m2SketchMode=mode;
    window.m2SelectedMeasureIndex=-1;
    try{render();}catch(e){}
    return false;
  };
  window.m2SelectMeasure=function(index){
    var n=Number(index);
    window.m2SelectedMeasureIndex=isFinite(n)?Math.floor(n):-1;
    try{render();}catch(e){}
    return false;
  };
  function measuredPoints(d){
    d=d||{};var out=[],seen=[];
    function add(p){if(!p)return;var lat=Number(p.lat),lng=Number(p.lng),x=Number(p.x),y=Number(p.y);if(!isFinite(lat)||!isFinite(lng)||!isFinite(x)||!isFinite(y))return;
      for(var i=0;i<seen.length;i++){if(Math.abs(seen[i].lat-lat)<1e-8&&Math.abs(seen[i].lng-lng)<1e-8)return;}
      seen.push({lat:lat,lng:lng});out.push({lat:lat,lng:lng,x:x,y:y});
    }
    (d.points||[]).forEach(add);
    (d.lines||[]).forEach(function(line){(line||[]).forEach(add);});
    return out;
  }
  function areaOfLine(line){
    if(!line||line.length<3)return 0;
    var sum=0,i,j;
    for(i=0;i<line.length;i++){j=(i+1)%line.length;sum+=Number(line[i].x)*Number(line[j].y)-Number(line[j].x)*Number(line[i].y);}
    return Math.abs(sum)/2;
  }
  function render(){
    var d=data(),rawPts=d.points||[],lines=d.lines||[],pts=measuredPoints(d),badge=q('m275Count'),svg=q('m275Sketch'),table=q('m275TableWrap'),out=q('m275OutputList'),areaEl=q('m277AreaValue');
    var pointCount=rawPts.length, lineItems=lines.filter(function(line){return line&&line.measureType!=='area';}), areaItems=lines.filter(function(line){return line&&line.measureType==='area';});
    var lineLen=0; lineItems.forEach(function(line){for(var li=1;li<line.length;li++){var ax=Number(line[li-1].x),ay=Number(line[li-1].y),bx=Number(line[li].x),by=Number(line[li].y);if(isFinite(ax)&&isFinite(ay)&&isFinite(bx)&&isFinite(by))lineLen+=Math.hypot(bx-ax,by-ay);}});
    var area=0;
    for(var ai=areaItems.length-1;ai>=0;ai--){var av=areaOfLine(areaItems[ai]);if(av>0){area=av;break;}}
    var pc=q('m2PointCount'),lc=q('m2LineCount'),ac=q('m2AreaCount'),live=q('m2LiveResult'),rl=q('m2ResultLabel');
    if(pc)pc.textContent=fa(pointCount); if(lc)lc.textContent=fa(lineItems.length); if(ac)ac.textContent=fa(areaItems.length);
    if(areaEl)areaEl.textContent=window.m2RealMode==='area'?(area>0?fmt(area,2)+' m²':'—'):(window.m2RealMode==='line'?(lineLen>0?fmt(lineLen,2)+' متر':'—'):(pointCount?fa(pointCount)+' نقطه':'—'));

  function m275SaveFile(name,blob,label){
    /* V285: Android must use the native save bridge first.
       The generic saveBlobFile path is browser/Telegram-oriented and can report
       success without actually creating an Android document. */
    try{
      if(window.AndroidBridge&&typeof window.miladgeoDirectSaveBlob==='function'){
        var nativeOk=window.miladgeoDirectSaveBlob(name,blob);
        if(nativeOk!==false)return true;
      }
    }catch(e){console.error('M275 Android export bridge failed',e)}
    try{
      if(typeof window.miladgeoExportBlob==='function'){
        var ok=window.miladgeoExportBlob(name,blob);
        if(ok!==false)return true;
      }
    }catch(e){console.error('M275 export primary failed',e)}
    try{
      if(typeof window.miladgeoDirectSaveBlob==='function'){
        var ok2=window.miladgeoDirectSaveBlob(name,blob);
        if(ok2!==false)return true;
      }
    }catch(e){console.error('M275 export bridge fallback failed',e)}
    try{
      var url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');
      a.href=url;a.download=name;a.rel='noopener';a.style.display='none';
      document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();
      setTimeout(function(){try{a.remove()}catch(e){}try{URL.revokeObjectURL(url)}catch(e){}},15000);
      showToast('✓ '+label+' آماده شد');
      return true;
    }catch(e){showToast('خروجی '+label+' ناموفق بود');return false}
  }
  function clearRealMeasurePoints(){
    if(!ptsHasAny())return false;
    if(!window.confirm('تمام نقاط برداشت‌شده پاک شوند؟'))return false;
    try{
      if(typeof window.miladgeoClearRealMeasurePoints==='function'){
        window.miladgeoClearRealMeasurePoints();
      }else return false;
    }catch(e){showToast('پاک کردن نقاط انجام نشد');return false}
    /* V299: WebView/file pages do not reliably refresh with location.reload().
       Rebuild Menu 2 immediately from the cleared Menu 17 state, then request
       a real navigation refresh as a secondary step. */
    try{ render(); }catch(e){}
    try{ if(typeof window.m275Refresh==='function') window.m275Refresh(); }catch(e){}
    setTimeout(function(){
      try{
        var active=q('realStake');
        if(active && active.classList.contains('active')) render();
        if(window.AndroidBridge && typeof window.AndroidBridge.refreshPage==='function'){
          window.AndroidBridge.refreshPage();
        }
      }catch(e){}
    },180);
    return false;
  }
  function ptsHasAny(){try{var d=data();return (d.points||[]).length>0||(d.lines||[]).some(function(line){return line&&line.length>0})}catch(e){return false}}
  window.m2OpenMap=function(){try{window.m17FromMeasureMenu2=true;showPage('menu17');setTimeout(function(){if(typeof m17Init==='function')m17Init();if(typeof setDrawMode==='function')setDrawMode(window.m2RealMode||'point');if(typeof window.m17UpdateEntryButton==='function')window.m17UpdateEntryButton();},120);}catch(e){showToast('باز کردن نقشه انجام نشد')}return false};
  window.m2OpenList=function(){try{var el=q('m275TableWrap');if(el)el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});}catch(e){}return false};
  window.m275Refresh=render;
  /* V396 — return from Menu 17 to the exact matching Menu 2 schematic.
     The redraw happens before scrolling so users immediately see the finished
     point, line, or area rather than the previously selected schematic tab. */
  window.m2ReturnToSchematic=function(mode){
    mode=(mode==='line'||mode==='area')?mode:'point';
    window.m2RealMode=mode;
    window.m2SketchMode=mode;
    window.m2SelectedMeasureIndex=-1;
    function refreshAndFocus(){
      var page=q('realMeasure');
      if(!page||!page.classList.contains('active'))return;
      try{render();}catch(e){console.error('M2_SCHEMATIC_REDRAW',e);}
      var panel=page.querySelector('.m2-pro-sketch-panel');
      if(!panel)return;
      try{
        panel.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
      }catch(e){
        try{window.scrollTo(0,Math.max(0,panel.getBoundingClientRect().top+(window.pageYOffset||0)-12));}catch(x){}
      }
    }
    /* Allow showPage's own 80 ms refresh to complete before focusing. */
    setTimeout(refreshAndFocus,100);
    return false;
  };
  var clearBtn=q('m277ClearPoints');if(clearBtn&&!clearBtn.dataset.bound){clearBtn.dataset.bound='1';clearBtn.addEventListener('click',clearRealMeasurePoints)}
  function m275ExportData(){
    var d=data(), rawPts=d.points||[], lines=d.lines||[];
    var rows=[], byKey={};
    function num(v){var n=Number(v);return isFinite(n)?n:0;}
    function keyOf(p){return num(p.x).toFixed(4)+'|'+num(p.y).toFixed(4);}
    function findJobPoint(x,y){
      try{
        if(!Array.isArray(points))return null;
        var best=null,bestDist=Infinity;
        points.forEach(function(p){var dx=num(p.x)-x,dy=num(p.y)-y,dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(dist<0.01&&dist<bestDist){best=p;bestDist=dist;}});
        return best;
      }catch(e){return null}
    }
    function addPoint(p,tag){
      if(!p)return;
      var x=num(p.x),y=num(p.y),lat=num(p.lat),lng=num(p.lng),k=keyOf({x:x,y:y}),r=byKey[k];
      if(!r){
        var jp=findJobPoint(x,y);
        r={name:jp&&jp.no?String(jp.no):('P'+(rows.length+1)),x:x,y:y,z:jp&&isFinite(Number(jp.z))?Number(jp.z):0,d:new Set(),lat:lat,lng:lng};
        byKey[k]=r;rows.push(r);
      }
      if(isFinite(lat)&&lat!==0)r.lat=lat;if(isFinite(lng)&&lng!==0)r.lng=lng;
      r.d.add(tag);
    }
    rawPts.forEach(function(p){addPoint(p,'POINT');});
    var lineItems=[],areaItems=[],li=0,ai=0;
    lines.forEach(function(line){
      if(!line||line.length<2)return;
      var isArea=line.measureType==='area';
      var item={points:line.map(function(p){return {x:num(p.x),y:num(p.y),lat:num(p.lat),lng:num(p.lng)}})};
      if(isArea){ai++;item.index=ai;areaItems.push(item);item.points.forEach(function(p){addPoint(p,'AREA '+ai);});}
      else{li++;item.index=li;lineItems.push(item);item.points.forEach(function(p){addPoint(p,'LINE '+li);});}
    });
    rows.forEach(function(r){r.d=Array.from(r.d).join(' / ');});
    function dist(a,b){return Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y);}
    lineItems.forEach(function(item){item.length=0;for(var i=1;i<item.points.length;i++)item.length+=dist(item.points[i-1],item.points[i]);});
    function polyArea(pts){var s=0;if(!pts||pts.length<3)return 0;for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i++){var j=(i+1)%pts.length;s+=pts[i].x*pts[j].y-pts[j].x*pts[i].y;}return Math.abs(s)/2;}
    areaItems.forEach(function(item){item.area=polyArea(item.points);item.perimeter=0;for(var i=0;i<item.points.length;i++)item.perimeter+=dist(item.points[i],item.points[(i+1)%item.points.length]);});
    return {rows:rows,rawPoints:rawPts,lineItems:lineItems,areaItems:areaItems};
  }
  function m275Svg(kind,ed){
    var sets=[];
    if(kind==='points')sets=[{pts:ed.rawPoints||[],closed:false,label:'points'}];
    else if(kind==='lines')sets=(ed.lineItems||[]).map(function(x){return {pts:x.points,closed:false,label:'LINE '+x.index}});
    else sets=(ed.areaItems||[]).map(function(x){return {pts:x.points,closed:true,label:'AREA '+x.index}});
    var pts=[];sets.forEach(function(s){(s.pts||[]).forEach(function(p){pts.push(p);});});
    if(!pts.length)return '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 330"><rect width="800" height="330" rx="16" fill="#eef2ea"/><text x="400" y="170" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial,Tahoma" font-size="22" fill="#687166">داده‌ای برای نمایش وجود ندارد</text></svg>';
    var minX=Math.min.apply(null,pts.map(function(p){return p.x})),maxX=Math.max.apply(null,pts.map(function(p){return p.x})),minY=Math.min.apply(null,pts.map(function(p){return p.y})),maxY=Math.max.apply(null,pts.map(function(p){return p.y})),dx=maxX-minX||1,dy=maxY-minY||1,pad=58,w=800,h=330;
    function sc(p){return {x:pad+(p.x-minX)/dx*(w-2*pad),y:h-pad-(p.y-minY)/dy*(h-2*pad)}}
    var s='<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 '+w+' '+h+'" style="width:100%;height:auto;background:#eef2ea;border:1px solid #7c8678;border-radius:12px"><line x1="'+pad+'" y1="'+(h-pad)+'" x2="'+(w-pad)+'" y2="'+(h-pad)+'" stroke="#aab3a6"/><line x1="'+pad+'" y1="'+pad+'" x2="'+pad+'" y2="'+(h-pad)+'" stroke="#aab3a6"/>';
    function pointLabel(p,fallbackIndex){
      try{
        var best=null,bestD=Infinity;
        (ed.rows||[]).forEach(function(r){var dx=Number(r.x)-Number(p.x),dy=Number(r.y)-Number(p.y),dd=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(dd<bestD){bestD=dd;best=r;}});
        if(best&&bestD<0.01&&best.name)return String(best.name);
      }catch(e){}
      return 'P'+fallbackIndex;
    }
    sets.forEach(function(set){var ps=set.pts||[];if(!ps.length)return;var q=ps.map(sc),poly=q.map(function(p){return p.x.toFixed(1)+','+p.y.toFixed(1)}).join(' ');if(set.closed&&q.length>=3)s+='<polygon points="'+poly+'" fill="#b9d7b9" fill-opacity="0.45" stroke="#2e6b35" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>';else if(q.length>=2)s+='<polyline points="'+poly+'" fill="none" stroke="#2e6b35" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>';if(set.closed&&q.length>=3){var cx=q.reduce(function(a,p){return a+p.x},0)/q.length,cy=q.reduce(function(a,p){return a+p.y},0)/q.length;s+='<g><rect x="'+(cx-42).toFixed(1)+'" y="'+(cy-13).toFixed(1)+'" width="84" height="26" rx="7" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="#2e6b35" stroke-width="2"/><text x="'+cx.toFixed(1)+'" y="'+(cy+6).toFixed(1)+'" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial,Tahoma" font-size="14" font-weight="900" fill="#173d1d">'+esc(set.label||'AREA')+'</text></g>';}q.forEach(function(p,i){s+='<circle cx="'+p.x.toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+p.y.toFixed(1)+'" r="7" fill="#1976d2" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3"/><text x="'+(p.x+11).toFixed(1)+'" y="'+(p.y-11).toFixed(1)+'" font-family="Arial,Tahoma" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#111">'+esc(pointLabel(ps[i],i+1))+'</text>';});});
    return s+'</svg>';
  }
  function m275ExportHtml(kind,ed,base){
    /* V398: shared point-name resolver for all PDF sections.  Keep it at the
       function scope so AREA PDF cannot lose the helper used by LINE PDF. */
    function m275NamedPoint(ed,p,i){
      var best=null,bestD=Infinity;
      (ed.rows||[]).forEach(function(r){
        var dx=Number(r.x)-Number(p.x),dy=Number(r.y)-Number(p.y),dd=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
        if(dd<bestD){bestD=dd;best=r;}
      });
      return best&&bestD<0.01&&best.name?String(best.name):'P'+(i+1);
    }
    var title=kind==='points'?'📍 گزارش PDF نقاط':(kind==='lines'?'📏 گزارش PDF خطوط':'📐 گزارش PDF مساحت');
    var summary=kind==='points'?'تعداد نقاط: '+fa(ed.rows.filter(function(r){return r.d.indexOf('POINT')>=0;}).length):kind==='lines'?'تعداد خطوط: '+fa(ed.lineItems.length):'تعداد مساحت‌ها: '+fa(ed.areaItems.length);
    var table='';
    if(kind==='points'){
      var pr=ed.rows.filter(function(r){return r.d.indexOf('POINT')>=0;});
      table='<table><thead><tr><th>Point</th><th>E / X</th><th>N / Y</th><th>Z</th><th>D</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+pr.map(function(r){return '<tr><td>'+esc(r.name)+'</td><td>'+fmt(r.x,2)+'</td><td>'+fmt(r.y,2)+'</td><td>'+fmt(r.z,2)+'</td><td>'+esc(r.d)+'</td></tr>';}).join('')+'</tbody></table>';
    }else if(kind==='lines'){
      var lineSummary='<table><thead><tr><th>خط</th><th>تعداد نقاط</th><th>طول (m)</th><th>نقاط</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+ed.lineItems.map(function(it){return '<tr><td>LINE '+fa(it.index)+'</td><td>'+fa(it.points.length)+'</td><td>'+fmt(it.length,2)+'</td><td>'+it.points.map(function(p,i){return esc(m275NamedPoint(ed,p,i))}).join(' — ')+'</td></tr>';}).join('')+'</tbody></table>';
      var linePoints=[];
      ed.lineItems.forEach(function(it){
        it.points.forEach(function(p,i){
          var name='P'+(i+1);
          var best=null,bestD=Infinity;
          ed.rows.forEach(function(r){var dx=Number(r.x)-Number(p.x),dy=Number(r.y)-Number(p.y),dd=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(dd<bestD){bestD=dd;best=r;}});
          if(best&&bestD<0.01)name=best.name;
          linePoints.push('<tr><td>LINE '+fa(it.index)+'</td><td>'+esc(name)+'</td><td>'+fmt(p.x,2)+'</td><td>'+fmt(p.y,2)+'</td><td>'+fmt((best&&isFinite(Number(best.z))?Number(best.z):0),2)+'</td></tr>');
        });
      });
      table=lineSummary+'<h2>مختصات نقاط خطوط</h2><table><thead><tr><th>خط</th><th>نقطه</th><th>X / Easting</th><th>Y / Northing</th><th>Z</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+linePoints.join('')+'</tbody></table>';
    }else{
      var areaSummary='<table><thead><tr><th>مساحت</th><th>تعداد نقاط</th><th>مساحت (m²)</th><th>محیط (m)</th><th>نقاط</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+ed.areaItems.map(function(it){return '<tr><td>AREA '+fa(it.index)+'</td><td>'+fa(it.points.length)+'</td><td>'+fmt(it.area,2)+'</td><td>'+fmt(it.perimeter,2)+'</td><td>'+it.points.map(function(p,i){return esc(m275NamedPoint(ed,p,i))}).join(' — ')+'</td></tr>';}).join('')+'</tbody></table>';
      var areaPoints=[];
      ed.areaItems.forEach(function(it){
        it.points.forEach(function(p,i){
          var name='P'+(i+1);
          var best=null,bestD=Infinity;
          ed.rows.forEach(function(r){var dx=Number(r.x)-Number(p.x),dy=Number(r.y)-Number(p.y),dd=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(dd<bestD){bestD=dd;best=r;}});
          if(best&&bestD<0.01)name=best.name;
          areaPoints.push('<tr><td>AREA '+fa(it.index)+'</td><td>'+esc(name)+'</td><td>'+fmt(p.x,2)+'</td><td>'+fmt(p.y,2)+'</td><td>'+fmt((best&&isFinite(Number(best.z))?Number(best.z):0),2)+'</td></tr>');
        });
      });
      table=areaSummary+'<h2>مختصات نقاط مساحت</h2><table><thead><tr><th>مساحت</th><th>نقطه</th><th>X / Easting</th><th>Y / Northing</th><th>Z</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+areaPoints.join('')+'</tbody></table>';
    }
    var html='<!doctype html><html dir="rtl"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>'+esc(base+'_'+kind+'.pdf')+'</title><style>@page{size:A4 portrait;margin:10mm}body{font-family:Arial,Tahoma,sans-serif;color:#111;padding:8px;line-height:1.6}h1{text-align:center;font-size:21px;margin:0 0 4px}h2{font-size:15px;margin:16px 0 7px;border-bottom:2px solid #555;padding-bottom:4px}.meta{text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#555;margin-bottom:12px}.box{border:1px solid #777;border-radius:10px;padding:8px;background:#f3f6f1;margin-bottom:12px}.sketch{direction:ltr}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:10px;direction:ltr}th,td{border:1px solid #777;padding:6px;text-align:center}th{background:#e2e9df;font-weight:bold}.foot{margin-top:12px;text-align:center;font-size:9px;color:#666}</style></head><body><h1>MiladGeo — '+title+'</h1><div class="meta">'+esc((typeof job!=='undefined'&&job.name?String(job.name):'MiladGeo'))+' | '+summary+' | '+new Date().toLocaleString('fa-IR')+'</div><div class="box sketch">'+m275Svg(kind,ed)+'</div><h2>فهرست اطلاعات</h2>'+table+'<div class="foot">تهیه‌شده توسط MiladGeo</div></body></html>';
    return html;
  }
  function m275PrintPdf(kind,ed,base){
    var has=kind==='points'?(ed.rows.some(function(r){return r.d.indexOf('POINT')>=0;})):kind==='lines'?ed.lineItems.length>0:ed.areaItems.length>0;
    if(!has){showToast(kind==='points'?'هنوز نقطه‌ای برای PDF ثبت نشده است':kind==='lines'?'هنوز خطی برای PDF ثبت نشده است':'هنوز مساحتی برای PDF ثبت نشده است');return false;}
    var html;
    try{html=m275ExportHtml(kind,ed,base);}catch(e){console.error('M275 PDF HTML',e);showToast('ساخت گزارش PDF '+(kind==='points'?'نقاط':kind==='lines'?'خطوط':'مساحت')+' ناموفق بود');return false;}
    try{if(typeof window.miladgeoM17PrintHtml==='function'){var printed=window.miladgeoM17PrintHtml(html,'MiladGeo '+kind+' PDF');if(printed!==false){showToast('✓ PDF '+(kind==='points'?'نقاط':kind==='lines'?'خطوط':'مساحت')+' آماده شد');return false;}}}catch(e){console.error('M275 PDF native',e)}
    try{var w=window.open('','_blank');if(!w){showToast('پنجره چاپ توسط مرورگر مسدود شده است');return false;}w.document.write(html);w.document.close();setTimeout(function(){try{w.focus();w.print()}catch(e){}},600);}catch(e){showToast('ساخت PDF ناموفق بود');}return false;
  }
  window.m275Export=function(type){
    var ed=m275ExportData(),base=(typeof job!=='undefined'&&job.name?String(job.name):'MiladGeo')+'_REAL_MEASURE';
    if(type==='xlsx'){
      if(!ed.rows.length){showToast('هنوز نقطه‌ای برای خروجی Excel ثبت نشده است');return false;}
      if(typeof XLSX==='undefined'){showToast('موتور Excel در دسترس نیست');return false;}
      try{
        var rows=ed.rows.map(function(r){return {P:r.name,E:r.x,N:r.y,Z:r.z,D:r.d};});
        var ws=XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(rows,{header:['P','E','N','Z','D']});
        ws['!cols']=[{wch:12},{wch:16},{wch:16},{wch:12},{wch:28}];
        var wb=XLSX.utils.book_new();XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb,ws,'PENZD');
        var out=XLSX.write(wb,{bookType:'xlsx',type:'array'});
        m275SaveFile(base+'_PENZD.xlsx',new Blob([out],{type:'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'}),'Excel');
      }catch(e){console.error('M275 XLSX',e);showToast('ساخت Excel ناموفق بود');}
    }else if(type==='txt'){
      var lines=['MiladGeo — گزارش کامل برداشت واقعی','========================================','JOB: '+(typeof job!=='undefined'&&job.name?String(job.name):'MiladGeo'),'DATE: '+new Date().toLocaleString('fa-IR'),'','📍 نقاط: '+ed.rawPoints.length,'📏 خطوط: '+ed.lineItems.length,'📐 مساحت‌ها: '+ed.areaItems.length,''];
      if(ed.rawPoints.length){lines.push('--- نقاط ---');ed.rows.filter(function(r){return r.d.indexOf('POINT')>=0;}).forEach(function(r){lines.push(r.name+' | X='+fmt(r.x,2)+' | Y='+fmt(r.y,2)+' | Z='+fmt(r.z,2)+' | D='+r.d);});lines.push('');}
      if(ed.lineItems.length){lines.push('--- خطوط / مسیرها ---');ed.lineItems.forEach(function(it){lines.push('LINE '+it.index+' | طول='+fmt(it.length,2)+' m | نقاط='+it.points.map(function(_,i){return 'P'+(i+1)}).join(', '));});lines.push('');}
      if(ed.areaItems.length){lines.push('--- مساحت‌ها ---');ed.areaItems.forEach(function(it){lines.push('AREA '+it.index+' | مساحت='+fmt(it.area,2)+' m² | محیط='+fmt(it.perimeter,2)+' m | نقاط='+it.points.map(function(_,i){return 'P'+(i+1)}).join(', '));});}
      m275SaveFile(base+'.txt',new Blob([lines.join('\r\n')],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'}),'گزارش متنی');
    }else if(type==='kml'){
      if(!ed.rows.length&&!ed.lineItems.length&&!ed.areaItems.length){showToast('هنوز برداشت واقعی ثبت نشده است');return false;}
      var k=['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>','<kml xmlns="http://www.opengis.net/kml/2.2"><Document><name>'+esc(base)+'</name>'];
      if(ed.rows.length){k.push('<Folder><name>POINTS</name>');ed.rows.forEach(function(r){if(isFinite(r.lat)&&isFinite(r.lng)&&r.lat!==0&&r.lng!==0)k.push('<Placemark><name>'+esc(r.name)+'</name><description>'+esc(r.d)+'</description><Point><coordinates>'+r.lng+','+r.lat+',0</coordinates></Point></Placemark>');});k.push('</Folder>');}
      ed.lineItems.forEach(function(it){k.push('<Placemark><name>LINE '+it.index+'</name><description>Length: '+fmt(it.length,2)+' m</description><LineString><tessellate>1</tessellate><coordinates>'+it.points.map(function(p){return p.lng+','+p.lat+',0'}).join(' ')+'</coordinates></LineString></Placemark>');});
      ed.areaItems.forEach(function(it){var pp=it.points.slice();if(pp.length&& (pp[0].lat!==pp[pp.length-1].lat||pp[0].lng!==pp[pp.length-1].lng))pp.push(pp[0]);k.push('<Placemark><name>AREA '+it.index+'</name><description>Area: '+fmt(it.area,2)+' m2; Perimeter: '+fmt(it.perimeter,2)+' m</description><Polygon><outerBoundaryIs><LinearRing><tessellate>1</tessellate><coordinates>'+pp.map(function(p){return p.lng+','+p.lat+',0'}).join(' ')+'</coordinates></LinearRing></outerBoundaryIs></Polygon></Placemark>');});
      k.push('</Document></kml>');m275SaveFile(base+'.kml',new Blob([k.join('')],{type:'application/vnd.google-earth.kml+xml'}),'KML');
    }else if(type==='pdf_points')return m275PrintPdf('points',ed,base+'_POINTS');
    else if(type==='pdf_lines')return m275PrintPdf('lines',ed,base+'_LINES');
    else if(type==='pdf_areas')return m275PrintPdf('areas',ed,base+'_AREAS');
    return false;
  };
})();
</script>
<script>
/* V368 bridge: persist real field measured points into the active JOB. */
window.miladgeoAddMeasuredPointToJob=function(lat,lng,z,dp,name){
  try{return window.miladGeoAddPointToJob({lat:lat,lng:lng,z:z,dp:dp,name:name||''});}
  catch(e){console.error('ADD_MEASURED_POINT_JOB',e);return false;}
};
</script>
<script id="menu3-stakeout-v350">
(function(){
'use strict';
var list=[],activeIndex=-1;
/* V351: professional point search/select layer; existing stakeout logic preserved. */
function q(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function esc(v){return String(v==null?'':v).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]})}
function num(v){var x=Number(String(v==null?'':v).replace(/,/g,'').trim());return isFinite(x)?x:NaN}
function zoneFromCurrent(){
  try{var z=q('stake3Zone');if(z&&(!z.value||!/^\d+$/.test(z.value))){var zz=typeof window.m17GetCurrentZone==='function'?Number(window.m17GetCurrentZone()):39;if(!isFinite(zz)||zz<1||zz>60)zz=39;z.value=String(zz)}}catch(e){}
}
function normalizeName(v,i){v=String(v==null?'':v).trim();return v||('P'+(i+1))}
function stake3SearchNormalize(v){
  return String(v==null?'':v).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'').replace(/^p(?=\d)/,'');
}
function stake3SearchPoint(){
  var inp=q('stake3SearchInput'),box=q('stake3SearchResult');if(!inp||!box)return false;
  var query=stake3SearchNormalize(inp.value);
  if(!query){box.className='stake3-search-result show';box.innerHTML='<div class="stake3-search-notfound">شماره یا نام نقطه را وارد کن.</div>';return false;}
  var found=-1;
  for(var si=0;si<list.length;si++){
    var nm=stake3SearchNormalize(normalizeName(list[si].name,si));
    if(nm===query || nm.indexOf(query)>=0){found=si;break;}
  }
  if(found<0){
    box.className='stake3-search-result show';
    box.innerHTML='<div class="stake3-search-notfound">نقطه «'+esc(inp.value)+'» پیدا نشد.</div>';
    return false;
  }
  activeIndex=found;
  render();
  var p=list[found],name=normalizeName(p.name,found);
  var coordHtml='';
  if(p.kind==='geo'){
    coordHtml='<div class="stake3-selected-cell"><small>طول</small><b>'+Number(p.lng).toFixed(6)+'</b></div>'+
              '<div class="stake3-selected-cell"><small>عرض</small><b>'+Number(p.lat).toFixed(6)+'</b></div>';
  }else{
    coordHtml='<div class="stake3-selected-cell"><small>X / Easting</small><b>'+Number(p.x).toFixed(2)+'</b></div>'+
              '<div class="stake3-selected-cell"><small>Y / Northing</small><b>'+Number(p.y).toFixed(2)+'</b></div>';
  }
  box.className='stake3-search-result show';
  box.innerHTML='<div class="stake3-selected-head"><span class="stake3-selected-name">'+esc(name)+'</span><span class="stake3-selected-badge">'+(p.done?'✓ پیاده شده':'نقطه انتخاب شد')+'</span></div>'+
    '<div class="stake3-selected-grid">'+coordHtml+
    '<div class="stake3-selected-cell"><small>شماره در لیست</small><b>'+fa(found+1)+'</b></div></div>'+
    '<div class="stake3-selected-action"><button class="btn primary" type="button" id="stake3SearchGo">'+(p.done?'✓ این نقطه قبلاً پیاده شده':'🎯 پیاده‌سازی '+esc(name))+'</button></div>';
  var go=q('stake3SearchGo');
  if(go&&!p.done)go.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();startIndex(found);});
  setTimeout(function(){
    var row=box.closest ? null : null;
    var listBox=q('stake3List');
    if(listBox){
      var target=listBox.querySelector('[data-stake3-index="'+found+'"]');
      if(target&&target.parentElement)target.parentElement.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});
    }
  },40);
  return false;
}
function render(){
  var box=q('stake3List'),prog=q('stake3Progress');if(!box)return;
  var done=list.filter(function(p){return p.done}).length;
  if(prog)prog.textContent=fa(done)+' / '+fa(list.length)+' نقطه پیاده شده';
  if(!list.length){box.innerHTML='<div class="stake3-empty">هنوز نقطه‌ای برای پیاده‌سازی وارد نشده است.</div>';return;}
  box.innerHTML=list.map(function(p,i){
    var status=p.done?'✓':(i===activeIndex?'🎯':'⏳');
    var cls='stake3-row'+(p.done?' done':'')+(i===activeIndex?' active':'');
    var coord=p.kind==='geo'?(Number(p.lat).toFixed(6)+' , '+Number(p.lng).toFixed(6)):(Number(p.x).toFixed(2)+' , '+Number(p.y).toFixed(2));
    var action=p.done?'<span class="stake3-status">✓</span>':'<button class="btn primary stake3-go" type="button" data-stake3-index="'+i+'">پیاده‌سازی</button>';
    return '<div class="'+cls+'"><div class="stake3-status">'+status+'</div><div class="stake3-point">'+esc(normalizeName(p.name,i))+'</div><div class="stake3-coord">'+esc(coord)+'</div><div>'+action+'</div></div>';
  }).join('');
  box.querySelectorAll('[data-stake3-index]').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();startIndex(Number(b.getAttribute('data-stake3-index')));});});
}
function fa(v){return String(v).replace(/\d/g,function(x){return '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'[x]})}
function startIndex(i){
  if(!list[i]||list[i].done)return false;
  var p=list[i];activeIndex=i;
  if(p.kind==='utm'){
    var zone=num(p.zone);if(!isFinite(zone)||zone<1||zone>60){showToast('UTM Zone را برای نقاط PenZD صحیح وارد کن');return false;}
    if(typeof window.m17ConvertUtmToWgs84!=='function'){showToast('ارتباط با نقشه منوی ۱۷ آماده نیست');return false;}
    /* V309: PenZD UTM targets must use their own north/south hemisphere.
   Do not derive the hemisphere from the current GPS/map position. */
    var northern=Number(p.y)<10000000;
    var c=(typeof window.m17UtmToWgs84==='function')
      ? window.m17UtmToWgs84(Number(p.x),Number(p.y),zone,northern)
      : window.m17ConvertUtmToWgs84(Number(p.x),Number(p.y),zone);
    if(!c||!isFinite(c.lat)||!isFinite(c.lng)){showToast('تبدیل مختصات نقطه انجام نشد');return false;}
    p.lat=c.lat;p.lng=c.lng;
  }
  if(!isFinite(Number(p.lat))||!isFinite(Number(p.lng))){showToast('مختصات نقطه معتبر نیست');return false;}
  window.__stake3ActiveIndex=i;
  showPage('menu17');
  setTimeout(function(){try{if(typeof m17Init==='function')m17Init();if(typeof window.m17LiveOpen!=='function'){showToast('پیاده‌سازی زنده آماده نیست');return;}window.m17LiveOpen({lat:Number(p.lat),lng:Number(p.lng)},normalizeName(p.name,i));render();}catch(e){console.error('STAKE3_START',e);showToast('شروع پیاده‌سازی انجام نشد');}},180);
  return false;
}
window.stake3LiveFinished=function(target){
  var i=Number(window.__stake3ActiveIndex);if(!isFinite(i)||!list[i])return;
  var p=list[i];if(target){p.lat=Number(target.lat);p.lng=Number(target.lng)}p.done=true;
  try{
    var saved=window.miladGeoAddPointToJob({name:normalizeName(p.name,i),dp:p.dp||'STAKE OUT',x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z||0,lat:p.lat,lng:p.lng});
    if(!saved)console.warn('Stake-out point already exists in JOB or could not be converted');
  }catch(e){console.error('STAKE3_FINISH_JOB',e);}
  activeIndex=-1;window.__stake3ActiveIndex=-1;render();
  if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast(normalizeName(p.name,i)+' ✓ پیاده شد');
  setTimeout(function(){try{showPage('realStake');}catch(e){}},80);
  var next=-1;for(var j=i+1;j<list.length;j++)if(!list[j].done){next=j;break;}if(next<0)for(var k=0;k<list.length;k++)if(!list[k].done){next=k;break;}
  if(next>=0){activeIndex=next;render();}
};
function realStakeShowOnMap(){
  try{
    var el=function(id){return document.getElementById(id);};
    var method=(typeof realStakeMethod!=='undefined') ? realStakeMethod : 'utm';
    var data={method:method};

    if(method==='utm'){
      /* V296: only X/Y are transferred from Menu 3.
         Menu 17 creates/keeps its own UTM Zone when its real stake modal opens.
         Do NOT overwrite that Zone from Menu 3. */
      data.x=String(el('realStakeX')?el('realStakeX').value:'').replace(/,/g,'').trim();
      data.y=String(el('realStakeY')?el('realStakeY').value:'').replace(/,/g,'').trim();
      if(data.x===''||data.y===''){
        if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast('ابتدا X / Y را در منوی ۳ وارد کن');
        return false;
      }
      if(!isFinite(Number(data.x))||!isFinite(Number(data.y))){
        if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast('X / Y را صحیح وارد کن');
        return false;
      }
    }else{
      data.lng=String(el('realStakeLng')?el('realStakeLng').value:'').replace(/,/g,'').trim();
      data.lat=String(el('realStakeLat')?el('realStakeLat').value:'').replace(/,/g,'').trim();
      if(data.lng===''||data.lat===''){
        if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast('ابتدا طول و عرض جغرافیایی را در منوی ۳ وارد کن');
        return false;
      }
      if(!isFinite(Number(data.lat))||!isFinite(Number(data.lng))||Number(data.lat)<-90||Number(data.lat)>90||Number(data.lng)<-180||Number(data.lng)>180){
        if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast('طول و عرض جغرافیایی را صحیح وارد کن');
        return false;
      }
    }

    /* Open Menu 17 normally. showPage() initializes the map and attaches the
       real Menu 17 stake button handler. We then click that real button and
       copy the values directly into its real inputs. No live mode and no
       alternate renderer are involved. */
    showPage('menu17');
    setTimeout(function(){
      try{
        if(typeof m17Init==='function')m17Init();
        var stakeBtn=el('m17StakeBtn');
        if(stakeBtn) stakeBtn.click();

        setTimeout(function(){
          try{
            if(data.method==='utm'){
              var x=el('m17StakeX'),y=el('m17StakeY');
              if(!x||!y)throw new Error('Menu 17 X/Y fields not found');
              /* Keep the Zone exactly as Menu 17 created it. */              x.value=data.x; y.value=data.y;
              ['input','change','blur'].forEach(function(type){
                [x,y].forEach(function(node){try{node.dispatchEvent(new Event(type,{bubbles:true}));}catch(e){}});
              });
            }else{
              var lng=el('m17StakeLng'),lat=el('m17StakeLat');
              if(!lng||!lat)throw new Error('Menu 17 GEO fields not found');
              var geoBtn=el('m17StakeMethodGeo');
              if(geoBtn)geoBtn.click();
              lng.value=data.lng; lat.value=data.lat;
              ['input','change','blur'].forEach(function(type){
                [lng,lat].forEach(function(node){try{node.dispatchEvent(new Event(type,{bubbles:true}));}catch(e){}});
              });
            }
            if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast('مختصات از منوی ۳ وارد شد ✓');
          }catch(err){
            console.error('V296_FIELD_TRANSFER',err);
            if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast('پر کردن مختصات منوی ۱۷ انجام نشد');
          }
        },180);
      }catch(err){
        console.error('V296_MENU17_OPEN',err);
        if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast('باز کردن پنجره پیاده‌سازی منوی ۱۷ انجام نشد');
      }
    },350);
  }catch(err){
    console.error('V295_REAL_STAKE_MAP',err);
    if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast('ورود به پیاده‌سازی روی نقشه انجام نشد');
  }
  return false;
}

function stake3PrintReport(){
  try{
    if(!list.length){showToast('هنوز نقطه‌ای برای گزارش وجود ندارد');return false;}
    var rows='',pts=[],i,p,u;
    for(i=0;i<list.length;i++){
      p=list[i];
      var lat=Number(p.lat),lng=Number(p.lng),x=Number(p.x),y=Number(p.y),zone=Number(p.zone);
      if(p.kind==='utm' && (!isFinite(lat)||!isFinite(lng))){
        if(typeof window.m17ConvertUtmToWgs84!=='function')throw new Error('مبدل مختصات منوی ۱۷ آماده نیست');
        var c=window.m17ConvertUtmToWgs84(x,y,zone);lat=Number(c.lat);lng=Number(c.lng);
      }
      if(!isFinite(x)||!isFinite(y)){
        if(typeof wgs84ToUTM==='function'){u=wgs84ToUTM(lat,lng);x=u.x;y=u.y;zone=u.zone;}
      }
      if(!isFinite(lat)||!isFinite(lng)||!isFinite(x)||!isFinite(y))continue;
      pts.push({x:x,y:y,lat:lat,lng:lng,name:normalizeName(p.name,i),done:!!p.done,zone:zone});
    }
    if(!pts.length){showToast('مختصات معتبر برای گزارش پیدا نشد');return false;}
    for(i=0;i<pts.length;i++){
      p=pts[i];
      var prev='';
      if(i>0){var dx=p.x-pts[i-1].x,dy=p.y-pts[i-1].y;prev=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy).toFixed(2)}
      var hemi='';try{u=wgs84ToUTM(p.lat,p.lng);zone=u.zone;hemi=u.hemisphere||''}catch(e){}
      rows+='<tr><td>'+esc(p.name||('P'+(i+1)))+'</td><td>'+p.x.toFixed(2)+'</td><td>'+p.y.toFixed(2)+'</td><td>'+esc(String(zone||'')+hemi)+'</td><td>'+p.lng.toFixed(7)+'</td><td>'+p.lat.toFixed(7)+'</td><td>'+prev+'</td><td>'+esc(p.done?'✓ پیاده شد':'در انتظار')+'</td></tr>';
    }
    var sketchW=900,sketchH=430,pad=55,minX=pts[0].x,maxX=pts[0].x,minY=pts[0].y,maxY=pts[0].y;
    for(i=1;i<pts.length;i++){minX=Math.min(minX,pts[i].x);maxX=Math.max(maxX,pts[i].x);minY=Math.min(minY,pts[i].y);maxY=Math.max(maxY,pts[i].y)}
    var spanX=Math.max(maxX-minX,0.001),spanY=Math.max(maxY-minY,0.001),usableW=sketchW-2*pad,usableH=sketchH-2*pad,scale=Math.min(usableW/spanX,usableH/spanY),usedW=spanX*scale,usedH=spanY*scale,offX=(sketchW-usedW)/2,offY=(sketchH-usedH)/2;
    function sx(v){return offX+(v.x-minX)*scale} function sy(v){return sketchH-(offY+(v.y-minY)*scale)}
    var sketchSvg='';
    for(i=1;i<10;i++){var gx=sketchW/10*i,gy=sketchH/10*i;sketchSvg+='<line x1="'+gx.toFixed(1)+'" y1="0" x2="'+gx.toFixed(1)+'" y2="'+sketchH+'" stroke="#d7ddd5" stroke-width="1"/><line x1="0" y1="'+gy.toFixed(1)+'" x2="'+sketchW+'" y2="'+gy.toFixed(1)+'" stroke="#d7ddd5" stroke-width="1"/>'}
    if(pts.length>=2){var path='';for(i=0;i<pts.length;i++)path+=(i?' L ':'M ')+sx(pts[i]).toFixed(1)+' '+sy(pts[i]).toFixed(1);sketchSvg+='<path d="'+path+'" fill="none" stroke="#1b5e20" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>'}
    if(pts.length>=3){var areaPath='M '+sx(pts[0]).toFixed(1)+' '+sy(pts[0]).toFixed(1);for(i=1;i<pts.length;i++)areaPath+=' L '+sx(pts[i]).toFixed(1)+' '+sy(pts[i]).toFixed(1);areaPath+=' Z';sketchSvg='<defs><pattern id="stake3Hatch303" width="12" height="12" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(25)"><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="12" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="4" opacity="0.24"/></pattern></defs>'+sketchSvg+'<path d="'+areaPath+'" fill="url(#stake3Hatch303)" stroke="#1b5e20" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>'}
    for(i=0;i<pts.length;i++){var px=sx(pts[i]),py=sy(pts[i]),fill=pts[i].done?'#1976d2':'#f57c00';sketchSvg+='<circle cx="'+px.toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+py.toFixed(1)+'" r="8" fill="'+fill+'" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3"/><text x="'+(px+11).toFixed(1)+'" y="'+(py-11).toFixed(1)+'" font-size="18" font-family="Arial,Tahoma,sans-serif" font-weight="900" fill="#111" paint-order="stroke" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="4">'+esc(pts[i].name||('P'+(i+1)))+'</text>'}
    sketchSvg+='<line x1="45" y1="85" x2="45" y2="35" stroke="#222" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M45 25 L36 42 L45 37 L54 42 Z" fill="#222"/><text x="37" y="18" font-size="18" font-family="Arial" font-weight="700">N</text>';
    var sketch='<div class="sketch-title">📐 ترسیم شماتیکی نقاط پیاده‌سازی</div><div class="sketch-wrap"><svg class="sketch" viewBox="0 0 '+sketchW+' '+sketchH+'" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">'+sketchSvg+'</svg></div>';
    var html='<!doctype html><html dir="rtl"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>MiladGeo Menu 3 Report</title><style>@page{size:A4 portrait;margin:9mm}html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#fff;color:#111}body{font-family:Arial,Tahoma,sans-serif;padding:3px;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;max-width:190mm;margin:0 auto;overflow-x:hidden}h1{text-align:center;margin:3px 0 7px;font-size:21px}.meta{margin:4px 0;font-size:14px;text-align:center}.sketch-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:900;margin:8px 0 5px}.sketch-wrap{width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:center}.sketch{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;min-height:78mm;border:1.5px solid #555;background:#f7f8f5;box-sizing:border-box}.table-wrap{margin-top:8px;width:100%;overflow:hidden}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:8px;table-layout:fixed;direction:ltr}th,td{border:1px solid #777;padding:3px 2px;text-align:center;overflow:hidden;white-space:normal;word-break:break-word;line-height:1.25}th{background:#ddd;font-weight:700}.print-back{position:fixed;right:10px;top:10px;z-index:999;padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid #555;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#111;font-weight:900}@media print{.print-back{display:none!important}.sketch,.table-wrap{break-inside:avoid;page-break-inside:avoid}}</style></head><body><h1>گزارش منوی ۳ - MiladGeo</h1><div class="meta">تعداد نقاط: '+pts.length+' — پیاده‌شده: '+pts.filter(function(z){return z.done}).length+'</div>'+sketch+'<div class="table-wrap"><table><tr><th>شماره</th><th>X</th><th>Y</th><th>Zone</th><th>طول جغرافیایی</th><th>عرض جغرافیایی</th><th>فاصله از قبل (m)</th><th>وضعیت</th></tr>'+rows+'</table></div><button class="print-back" type="button" onclick="history.back()">↩ بازگشت</button></body></html>';
    /* Menu 3 uses the SAME native Android PDF delivery as Menu 17.
       IMPORTANT: do not fall back to window.open()/about:blank here. */
    try{
      if(window.AndroidBridge && typeof window.AndroidBridge.printHtml==='function'){
        window.AndroidBridge.printHtml(String(html));
        return false;
      }
      if(window.miladgeoNative && typeof window.miladgeoNative.printHtml==='function'){
        window.miladgeoNative.printHtml(String(html));
        return false;
      }
    }catch(nativeErr){
      console.error('STAKE3_NATIVE_PDF',nativeErr);
      showToast('خطا در آماده‌سازی PDF اندروید');
      return false;
    }
    showToast('مسیر خروجی PDF اندروید در دسترس نیست');
    return false;
  }catch(e){console.error('STAKE3_PDF',e);showToast('ساخت PDF منوی ۳ ناموفق بود');return false}
}
function clearList(){if(!list.length)return false;if(!confirm('تمام نقاط لیست پیاده‌سازی پاک شوند؟'))return false;list=[];activeIndex=-1;window.__stake3ActiveIndex=-1;render();showToast('لیست پیاده‌سازی پاک شد');return false;}
function setStatus(t){var e=q('stake3ImportStatus');if(e)e.textContent=t}
function addImported(arr,source){
  if(!arr.length){showToast('نقطه قابل استفاده پیدا نشد');return;}
  var added=0,jobAdded=0;
  arr.forEach(function(p){
    var name=String(p.name||'').trim()||('P'+(list.length+1));
    var exists=list.some(function(x){return x.name===name || (isFinite(Number(x.x))&&isFinite(Number(p.x))&&Math.abs(Number(x.x)-Number(p.x))<1e-6&&isFinite(Number(x.y))&&isFinite(Number(p.y))&&Math.abs(Number(x.y)-Number(p.y))<1e-6);});
    if(exists)return;
    list.push(p);added++;
    var beforeCount=Array.isArray(window.miladGeoGetPoints&&window.miladGeoGetPoints())?window.miladGeoGetPoints().length:0;
    var addedPoint=false;
    try{
      addedPoint=window.miladGeoAddPointToJob({name:name,dp:p.dp||'STAKE OUT',x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z||0,lat:p.lat,lng:p.lng});
    }catch(e){console.error('STAKE3_SAVE_JOB',e);}
    var afterCount=Array.isArray(window.miladGeoGetPoints&&window.miladGeoGetPoints())?window.miladGeoGetPoints().length:beforeCount;
    if(afterCount>beforeCount || addedPoint)jobAdded++;
  });
  try{if(typeof refreshPoints==='function')refreshPoints();if(typeof updateAllUI==='function')updateAllUI();}catch(e){}
  try{if(window.miladJobAutoSync362)window.miladJobAutoSync362(POINTS_KEY);}catch(e){}
  setStatus(added+' نقطه از '+source+' وارد شد'+(jobAdded?' — '+jobAdded+' نقطه به JOB اضافه شد':' — نقاط موجود در JOB بودند'));
  render();showToast(fa(added)+' نقطه وارد شد ✓'+(jobAdded?' — به JOB هم اضافه شد':' — در JOB موجود بود'));
}

function parseKml(text){
  var xml=new DOMParser().parseFromString(text,'application/xml');if(xml.getElementsByTagName('parsererror').length)throw new Error('KML معتبر نیست');
  var out=[],pms=xml.getElementsByTagName('Placemark');
  for(var i=0;i<pms.length;i++){var pm=pms[i],name=(pm.getElementsByTagName('name')[0]||{}).textContent||'';var pts=pm.getElementsByTagName('Point');for(var j=0;j<pts.length;j++){var c=pts[j].getElementsByTagName('coordinates')[0];if(!c)continue;var a=c.textContent.trim().split(/\s+/)[0].split(',');var lng=Number(a[0]),lat=Number(a[1]);if(isFinite(lat)&&isFinite(lng))out.push({name:name,kind:'geo',lat:lat,lng:lng,done:false});}}
  return out;
}
function readKmlFile(file){
  var r=new FileReader();
  if(/\.kmz$/i.test(file.name)||file.type==='application/vnd.google-earth.kmz'||file.type==='application/zip'){
    r.onload=function(e){if(!window.JSZip){var sc=document.createElement('script');sc.src='https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1/jszip.min.js';sc.onload=function(){readZip(window.JSZip,e.target.result)};sc.onerror=function(){showToast('برای KMZ اتصال اینترنت لازم است');};document.head.appendChild(sc);}else readZip(window.JSZip,e.target.result)};r.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
  }else{r.onload=function(e){try{addImported(parseKml(e.target.result),'KML')}catch(err){showToast('خطا در KML: '+err.message)}};r.readAsText(file,'UTF-8');}
}
function readZip(JSZip,data){JSZip.loadAsync(data).then(function(zip){var n=Object.keys(zip.files).find(function(x){return /(^|\/)doc\.kml$/i.test(x)||/\.kml$/i.test(x)});if(!n)throw new Error('KML داخل KMZ پیدا نشد');return zip.files[n].async('string')}).then(function(t){addImported(parseKml(t),'KMZ')}).catch(function(e){showToast('خطا در KMZ: '+e.message)})}
function excelRows(rows){
  var out=[];if(!rows||!rows.length)return out;
  function norm(v){return String(v==null?'':v).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[\s_\-\/\\().:]/g,'')}
  function idxBy(names,header){
    /* V348: resolve exact column aliases first.  Single-letter aliases
       such as N/E/X/Y must never match a longer word by substring
       (e.g. "Easting" contains "n", which previously mapped Northing
       to the Easting column in real PENZD Excel files). */
    for(var i=0;i<header.length;i++){
      var h=norm(header[i]);
      for(var j=0;j<names.length;j++){
        if(h===norm(names[j]))return i;
      }
    }
    /* Only use substring matching for descriptive aliases with 3+ chars. */
    for(var i2=0;i2<header.length;i2++){
      var h2=norm(header[i2]);
      for(var j2=0;j2<names.length;j2++){
        var n2=norm(names[j2]);
        if(n2.length>=3&&(h2.indexOf(n2)>=0||n2.indexOf(h2)>=0))return i2;
      }
    }
    return -1
  }
  var first=rows[0]||[], header=first.map(norm);
  var hasHeader=false;
  for(var h=0;h<header.length;h++){if(/^(point|pt|p|easting|east|x|northing|north|n|y|elevation|elev|z|description|desc|dp|code|d)$/.test(header[h])){hasHeader=true;break;}}
  var start=hasHeader?1:0;
  /* V349: for a simple 2-column coordinate Excel/CSV, the contract is explicit:
     column 1 = X/Easting, column 2 = Y/Northing. No PENZD guessing is allowed.
     Standard headered PENZD and headerless PNE/PENZD files keep their existing mapping. */
  var simpleXY = !hasHeader && first.length===2;
  var ip=hasHeader?idxBy(['point','pt','name','id','code','p'],header):-1;
  var ix=hasHeader?idxBy(['easting','east','x','e'],header):(simpleXY?0:1);
  var iy=hasHeader?idxBy(['northing','north','y','n'],header):(simpleXY?1:2);
  var iz=hasHeader?idxBy(['elevation','elev','height','z'],header):(simpleXY?-1:3);
  var id=hasHeader?idxBy(['description','desc','descriptionpoint','dp','code','d'],header):(simpleXY?-1:4);
  /* If the header is non-standard or mapping is incomplete, use the standard PENZD order P/E/N/Z/D. */
  if(ip<0 && !simpleXY)ip=0;
  if(ix<0)ix=simpleXY?0:1;
  if(iy<0)iy=simpleXY?1:2;
  if(iz<0 && !simpleXY)iz=3;
  for(var r=start;r<rows.length;r++){
    var row=rows[r]||[];
    if(!row.length)continue;
    var x=num(row[ix]),y=num(row[iy]);
    /* V347: many real survey exports have no header and are written as
       Point / Northing / Easting / Z / Description (PNEZD).
       The old fallback assumed P/E/N, which reversed the coordinates.
       Detect the characteristic UTM ranges only for headerless rows:
       Northing is normally > 1,000,000 while Easting is typically
       100,000–900,000. Headered files keep their explicit column mapping. */
    if(!hasHeader && isFinite(x) && isFinite(y) &&
       Math.abs(x)>1000000 && Math.abs(y)>=100000 && Math.abs(y)<=1000000){
      var tmpNoHeader=x;x=y;y=tmpNoHeader;
    }
    /* Headered survey files can explicitly arrive as Northing / Easting. */
    if(hasHeader&&header[ix]&&/(^n|north)/.test(header[ix])&&header[iy]&&/(^e|east)/.test(header[iy])){
      var tmp=x;x=y;y=tmp;
    }
    var z=iz<row.length?num(row[iz]):NaN;
    if(!isFinite(x)||!isFinite(y))continue;
    out.push({name:normalizeName(row[ip],out.length),kind:'utm',x:x,y:y,z:isFinite(z)?z:0,dp:id>=0&&id<row.length?String(row[id]==null?'':row[id]).trim():'',zone:num(q('stake3Zone')?q('stake3Zone').value:'39'),done:false});
  }
  return out;
}
function getStake3XlsxEngine(done){
  if(window.XLSX){done(window.XLSX);return;}
  if(typeof XLSX!=='undefined'){window.XLSX=XLSX;done(XLSX);return;}
  var old=document.getElementById('stake3XlsxLoader');
  if(old){old.addEventListener('load',function(){if(window.XLSX)done(window.XLSX);else done(null);},{once:true});old.addEventListener('error',function(){done(null);},{once:true});return;}
  var sc=document.createElement('script');sc.id='stake3XlsxLoader';sc.src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js';sc.onload=function(){done(window.XLSX||null)};sc.onerror=function(){done(null)};document.head.appendChild(sc);
}
function readExcel(file){
  if(!file)return;
  /* V302: Menu 3 Excel input follows the same direct FileReader/XLSX path as Menu 12.
     The parsed points still go only to the Menu 3 stakeout list. */
  var X=window.XLSX;
  if(!X && typeof XLSX!=='undefined')X=XLSX;
  if(!X){
    setStatus('موتور Excel در دسترس نیست؛ برنامه را یک‌بار دوباره لود کن');
    showToast('موتور Excel آماده نیست');
    return;
  }
  var r=new FileReader();
  r.onload=function(e){
    try{
      var data=new Uint8Array(e.target.result);
      var wb=X.read(data,{type:'array',cellDates:false,raw:true});
      var names=wb.SheetNames||[];
      if(!names.length)throw new Error('هیچ Sheetای در فایل پیدا نشد');
      var best=[],bestName=names[0];
      for(var si=0;si<names.length;si++){
        var ws=wb.Sheets[names[si]];
        var rows=X.utils.sheet_to_json(ws,{header:1,defval:'',raw:true,blankrows:false});
        var parsed=excelRows(rows);
        if(parsed.length>best.length){best=parsed;bestName=names[si];}
      }
      if(!best.length)throw new Error('ستون‌های PENZD پیدا نشد');
      addImported(best,'Excel / PenZD — '+bestName);
      setStatus(best.length+' نقطه از Excel وارد شد ✓');
    }catch(err){
      setStatus('خطا در Excel: '+(err.message||err));
      showToast('خواندن Excel ناموفق بود');
      console.error('STAKE3_EXCEL',err);
    }
  };
  r.onerror=function(){setStatus('خطا در خواندن فایل Excel');showToast('خواندن Excel ناموفق بود')};
  r.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
}

function init(){
  zoneFromCurrent();
  var ex=q('stake3ImportExcel'),kf=q('stake3ImportKml'),ef=q('stake3ExcelFile'),ff=q('stake3KmlFile'),lf=q('stake3LoadFile'),load=q('stake3LoadPoints'),cl=q('stake3Clear');
  if(load&&!load.dataset.bound){load.dataset.bound='1';load.addEventListener('click',function(){if(lf){lf.value='';lf.click()}})}
  if(lf&&!lf.dataset.bound){lf.dataset.bound='1';lf.addEventListener('change',function(){var f=this.files&&this.files[0];if(!f)return; if(/\.(kml|kmz)$/i.test(f.name)||/google-earth\.kmz|application\/zip/i.test(f.type)){readKmlFile(f)}else{readExcel(f)}})}
  if(ex&&!ex.dataset.bound){ex.dataset.bound='1';ex.addEventListener('click',function(){if(ef){ef.value='';ef.click()}})}
  if(kf&&!kf.dataset.bound){kf.dataset.bound='1';kf.addEventListener('click',function(){if(ff){ff.value='';ff.click()}})}
  if(ef&&!ef.dataset.bound){ef.dataset.bound='1';ef.addEventListener('change',function(){if(this.files&&this.files[0])readExcel(this.files[0])})}
  if(ff&&!ff.dataset.bound){ff.dataset.bound='1';ff.addEventListener('change',function(){if(this.files&&this.files[0])readKmlFile(this.files[0])})}
  if(cl&&!cl.dataset.bound){cl.dataset.bound='1';cl.addEventListener('click',clearList)}
  var sI=q('stake3SearchInput'),sB=q('stake3SearchBtn');
  if(sB&&!sB.dataset.bound){sB.dataset.bound='1';sB.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();stake3SearchPoint();})}
  if(sI&&!sI.dataset.bound){sI.dataset.bound='1';sI.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();stake3SearchPoint();}})}
  var z=q('stake3Zone');if(z&&!z.dataset.bound){z.dataset.bound='1';z.addEventListener('change',function(){list.forEach(function(p){if(p.kind==='utm')p.zone=num(z.value)});})}
  var pdf=q('stake3PdfReport');if(pdf&&!pdf.dataset.bound){pdf.dataset.bound='1';pdf.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();stake3PrintReport();})}
  render();
}
window.addEventListener('load',init);window.stake3Init=init;
var oldShow=window.showPage;
/* Refresh the list whenever Menu 3 is opened, while leaving the global navigation intact. */
var pageObserver=setInterval(function(){var pg=q('realStake');if(pg&&pg.classList.contains('active'))init();},700);window.addEventListener('beforeunload',function(){clearInterval(pageObserver)});
})();
</script>
<script id="m4-submenu-v317-runtime">
(function(){
  var m4CurrentSection='home',m4BackRestore=false;
  function m4ApplySection(mode){
    var home=document.getElementById('m4Submenu'),terrain=document.getElementById('m4TerrainSection'),leveling=document.getElementById('m4LevelingSection'),offline=document.getElementById('m4OfflineTerrainSection');
    if(!home||!terrain||!leveling||!offline)return false;
    m4CurrentSection=mode;home.style.display=(mode==='home')?'block':'none';
    terrain.classList.toggle('show',mode==='terrain');leveling.classList.toggle('show',mode==='leveling');offline.classList.toggle('show',mode==='offline');
    if(mode==='home'){window.scrollTo(0,0);}else{setTimeout(function(){var sec=mode==='terrain'?terrain:(mode==='offline'?offline:leveling);if(sec)sec.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:'smooth'});},30);}return false;
  }
  window.m4ShowSection=function(mode){
    if(!document.getElementById('m4Submenu'))return false;
    if(mode===m4CurrentSection)return false;
    if(!m4BackRestore&&mode!=='home'){
      try{history.pushState({m4Section:mode},'',location.pathname+location.search+'#leveling-m4-'+mode);}catch(e){}
    }
    return m4ApplySection(mode);
  };
  window.addEventListener('popstate',function(){
    var pg=document.getElementById('leveling');
    if(pg&&pg.classList.contains('active')&&m4CurrentSection!=='home'){
      m4BackRestore=true;m4ApplySection('home');m4BackRestore=false;
      try{history.replaceState({m4Section:'home'},'',location.pathname+location.search+'#leveling');}catch(e){}
    }
  });
  var m4OldShowPage=window.showPage;
  if(typeof m4OldShowPage==='function')window.showPage=function(id){var result=m4OldShowPage.apply(this,arguments);if(id==='leveling'){m4BackRestore=true;m4ApplySection('home');m4BackRestore=false;try{history.replaceState({m4Section:'home'},'',location.pathname+location.search+'#leveling');}catch(e){}}return result;};
  var m4OldGoBack=window.goBack;
  window.goBack=function(){
    var page=document.getElementById('leveling');
    var subIds=['m4OfflineTerrainSection','m4TerrainSection','m4LevelingSection'];
    var inSubpanel=page&&page.classList.contains('active')&&subIds.some(function(id){var el=document.getElementById(id);return el&&el.classList.contains('show');});
    if(inSubpanel){
      m4BackRestore=true;
      m4ApplySection('home');
      m4BackRestore=false;
      try{history.replaceState({m4Section:'home'},'',location.pathname+location.search+'#leveling');}catch(e){}
      return false;
    }
    return typeof m4OldGoBack==='function'?m4OldGoBack.apply(this,arguments):false;
  };
})();
</script>

function edgePoint(x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2,lev){if((z1<lev&&z2<lev)||(z1>lev&&z2>lev)||z1===z2)return null;var t=(lev-z1)/(z2-z1);return {x:x1+(x2-x1)*t,y:y1+(y2-y1)*t};}
function contours(grid,w,h,bbox,poly,step){var min=Infinity,max=-Infinity;for(var i=0;i<grid.length;i++){var z=Number(grid[i]);if(isFinite(z)){min=Math.min(min,z);max=Math.max(max,z);}}if(!isFinite(min)||!isFinite(max)||max<=min)return {min:min,max:max,segments:[]};var first=Math.ceil(min/step)*step,last=Math.floor(max/step)*step,segments=[];function ll(px,py){return {lng:bbox[0]+(px/(w-1))*(bbox[2]-bbox[0]),lat:bbox[3]-(py/(h-1))*(bbox[3]-bbox[1])};}
for(var lev=first;lev<=last+step*0.001;lev+=step){for(var y=0;y<h-1;y++){for(var x=0;x<w-1;x++){var i0=y*w+x,i1=i0+1,i3=(y+1)*w+x,i2=i3+1,z0=Number(grid[i0]),z1=Number(grid[i1]),z2=Number(grid[i2]),z3=Number(grid[i3]);if(!isFinite(z0)||!isFinite(z1)||!isFinite(z2)||!isFinite(z3))continue;var pts=[];var p=edgePoint(x,y,z0,x+1,y,z1,lev);if(p)pts.push(p);p=edgePoint(x+1,y,z1,x+1,y+1,z2,lev);if(p)pts.push(p);p=edgePoint(x+1,y+1,z2,x,y+1,z3,lev);if(p)pts.push(p);p=edgePoint(x,y+1,z3,x,y,z0,lev);if(p)pts.push(p);if(pts.length===2){var a=ll(pts[0].x,pts[0].y),b=ll(pts[1].x,pts[1].y);var mid={lat:(a.lat+b.lat)/2,lng:(a.lng+b.lng)/2};if(pointInPoly(mid,poly))segments.push({level:lev,a:a,b:b});}else if(pts.length===4){var pairs=[[0,1],[2,3]];for(var k=0;k<2;k++){var a1=ll(pts[pairs[k][0]].x,pts[pairs[k][0]].y),b1=ll(pts[pairs[k][1]].x,pts[pairs[k][1]].y),mid1={lat:(a1.lat+b1.lat)/2,lng:(a1.lng+b1.lng)/2};if(pointInPoly(mid1,poly))segments.push({level:lev,a:a1,b:b1});}}}}}return {min:min,max:max,segments:segments};}
function m4Wgs84ToUTM(lat,lon){

function dxfNumber(n){return Number(n).toFixed(3)}
function buildDXF(segs){var out=['0','SECTION','2','HEADER','9','$INSUNITS','70','6','0','ENDSEC','0','SECTION','2','ENTITIES'];segs.forEach(function(s){var a=m4Wgs84ToUTM(s.a.lat,s.a.lng),b=m4Wgs84ToUTM(s.b.lat,s.b.lng);out.push('0','LINE','8','CONTOUR_'+String(Math.round(s.level*100)/100).replace(/\./g,'_'),'10',dxfNumber(a.x),'20',dxfNumber(a.y),'30',dxfNumber(s.level),'11',dxfNumber(b.x),'21',dxfNumber(b.y),'31',dxfNumber(s.level));});out.push('0','ENDSEC','0','EOF');return out.join('\r\n');}
function saveBlob(name,blob){

    if(window.miladgeoNative&&typeof window.miladgeoNative.saveFile==='function'&&typeof window.miladgeoDirectSaveBlob==='function')return window.miladgeoDirectSaveBlob(name,blob);

function m4RenderTerrainPreview(){

  var w=760,h=360,pad=28,dx=(maxX-minX)||1,dy=(maxY-minY)||1,scale=Math.min((w-2*pad)/dx,(h-2*pad)/dy),ox=(w-dx*scale)/2,oy=(h-dy*scale)/2;

  for(var gy=1;gy<4;gy++){var yy=(h*gy/4).toFixed(1);grid+='<line x1="0" y1="'+yy+'" x2="'+w+'" y2="'+yy+'" stroke="#293029" stroke-width="1" opacity=".55"/>'; }
  var labelLevels=levelKeys.length>10?levelKeys.filter(function(v,i){return i%Math.ceil(levelKeys.length/10)===0;}):levelKeys;
  var legendRows=labelLevels.slice(0,10).map(function(v,i){return '<text x="585" y="'+(83+i*18)+'" font-size="11" fill="#e9eee8">'+String(v.toFixed(0))+' m</text><line x1="555" y1="'+(79+i*18)+'" x2="575" y2="'+(79+i*18)+'" stroke="'+(i%5===0?'#ffffff':'#aeb7ad')+'" stroke-width="'+(i%5===0?'1.4':'0.8')+'"/>';}).join('');

    '<g fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">'+lines+'</g>'+
    '<g><path d="M55 72 L55 30 M55 30 L46 42 M55 30 L64 42" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="3"/><text x="55" y="20" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="900" fill="#ffffff">N</text></g>'+
    '<g><line x1="35" y1="325" x2="'+(35+scalePx)+'" y2="325" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="35" y1="320" x2="35" y2="330" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="'+(35+scalePx)+'" y1="320" x2="'+(35+scalePx)+'" y2="330" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2"/><text x="'+(35+scalePx/2)+'" y="346" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#e9eee8">تقریباً '+scaleMeters.toLocaleString('fa-IR')+' متر</text></g>'+
    '<g><rect x="545" y="18" width="185" height="'+(105+Math.min(10,labelLevels.length)*18)+'" rx="9" fill="#101710" stroke="#7d897c" stroke-width="1.5" opacity=".96"/><text x="558" y="40" font-size="13" font-weight="900" fill="#ffffff">راهنمای نقشه</text><text x="558" y="59" font-size="10" fill="#bfc8be">خطوط میزان</text>'+legendRows+'</g>'+

window.m4TerrainMapParent=null;window.m4TerrainMapNext=null;window.m4TerrainMapOpen=false;

window.m4ReadTerrainSelection=function(){var poly=window.m17GetTerrainPolygon?window.m17GetTerrainPolygon():[];var box=q('m4TerrainSelection');if(!poly.length){if(box)box.textContent='انتخاب نشده';m4SetStep(1,false);m4SetStep(2,false);status('محدوده‌ای پیدا نشد؛ از مرحله ۱ روی نقشه یک محدوده ببند.');return false;}var a=polygonAreaApprox(poly);m4SetStep(1,true);m4SetStep(2,true);if(box)box.innerHTML='✓ '+poly.length+' راس<br>'+a.toFixed(0)+' m²';var del=q('m4DeleteTerrainSelection');if(del){del.disabled=false;del.style.opacity='1';del.style.cursor='pointer';}status('محدوده آماده است ✓ — حالا دریافت و تحلیل را بزن.');return true;};
window.m4DeleteTerrainSelection=function(){m4SetStep(1,false);m4SetStep(2,false);m4SetStep(3,false);m4SetStep(4,false);
  try{

    var preview=q('m4TerrainPreviewMeta');if(preview)preview.textContent='خطوط میزان پس از ساخت خروجی در این قسمت نمایش داده می‌شوند.';
    var chart=q('m4ProfileChart');if(chart)chart.innerHTML='';
    var pres=q('m4ProfileResult');if(pres)pres.style.display='none';
    var ps=q('m4ProfileStatus');if(ps){ps.style.display='block';ps.textContent='ابتدا تحلیل DEM را انجام بده.';}
    status('محدوده حذف شد — یک محدوده جدید روی نقشه انتخاب کن.');
    showToast('✓ محدوده انتخاب‌شده حذف شد.');
    return false;
  }catch(e){console.error('M4_DELETE_TERRAIN_SELECTION',e);showToast('حذف محدوده انجام نشد');return false;}
};
window.m4NativeDEMResult=function(ok,statusCode,b64,contentType,errorText){if(!window.m4NativeDEMResolve)return;var done=window.m4NativeDEMResolve;window.m4NativeDEMResolve=null;window.m4NativeDEMReject=null;if(!ok){done(Promise.reject(Error('Native HTTP '+statusCode+(errorText?' — '+errorText:''))));return;}try{var bin=atob(b64||''),buf=new ArrayBuffer(bin.length),u8=new Uint8Array(buf);for(var i=0;i<bin.length;i++)u8[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);done(Promise.resolve(buf));}catch(e){done(Promise.reject(e));}};
window.m4DownloadDEM=function(url){if(window.AndroidBridge&&typeof window.AndroidBridge.downloadBinary==='function'){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){window.m4NativeDEMResolve=function(p){p.then(resolve).catch(reject);};window.m4NativeDEMReject=reject;try{window.AndroidBridge.downloadBinary(url);}catch(e){window.m4NativeDEMResolve=null;window.m4NativeDEMReject=null;reject(e);}});}return fetch(url).then(function(r){if(!r.ok)throw Error('HTTP '+r.status);return r.arrayBuffer();});};
window.m4AnalyzeTerrain=function(){if(m4Busy)return false;var key=(q('m4OtKey')||{}).value||'';key=key.trim();if(!key){status('ابتدا OpenTopography API Key را وارد کن.');showToast('API Key لازم poly=window.m17GetTerrainPolygon?window.m17GetTerrainPolygon():[];if(poly.length<3){status('ابتدا محدوده را روی نقشه انتخاب کن.');showToast('محدوده انتخاب نشده');return false;}var bb=bounds(poly),src=(q('m4DemSource')||{}).value||'GEDTM30',step=Number((q('m4ContourStep')||{}).value||5);var span=Math.max(bb.east-bb.west,bb.north-bb.south);if(span>0.25){status('محدوده خیلی بزرگ است؛ برای تحلیل DEM محدوده کوچک‌تری انتخاب کن.');return false;}var url='https://portal.opentopography.org/API/globaldem?demtype='+encodeURIComponent(src)+'&south='+bb.south+'&north='+bb.north+'&west='+bb.west+'&east='+bb.east+'&outputFormat=GTiff&API_Key='+encodeURIComponent(key);m4Busy=true;status('⏳ در حال دریافت DEM و تحلیل توپوگرافی…');loadGeoTIFF(function(GeoTIFF){if(!GeoTIFF){m4Busy=false;status('کتابخانه GeoTIFF بارگذاری نشد؛ اتصال اینترنت را بررسی کن.');return;}if(window.AndroidBridge&&typeof window.AndroidBridge.downloadBinary==='function')status('در حال دریافت DEM از طریق اتصال مستقیم Android…');m4DownloadDEM(url).then(function(buf){return GeoTIFF.fromArrayBuffer(buf);}).then(function(tiff){return tiff.getImage();}).then(function(img){var bbox2=img.getBoundingBox(),w=img.getWidth(),h=img.getHeight();return img.readRasters({interleave:true}).then(function(r){return {r:r,w:w,h:h,bbox:bbox2,nodata:img.getGDALNoData&&img.getGDALNoData()};});}).then(function(d){var arr=d.r,nd=Number(d.nodata),clean=new Float64Array(arr.length);for(var i=0;i<arr.length;i++){var v=Number(arr[i]);clean[i]=(isFinite(v)&&(!isFinite(nd)||v!==nd))?v:NaN;}var c=contours(clean,d.w,d.h,d.bbox,poly,step);window.m4ResetProfileChecks&&window.m4ResetProfileChecks();m4ProfileLast=null;m4Last={segments:c.segments,min:c.min,max:c.max,source:src,step:step,vertices:poly.slice(),bbox:bb,raster:clean,width:d.w,height:d.h,rasterBbox:d.bbox};var r=q('m4TerrainResult');if(r)r.style.display='grid';if(q('m4MinZ'))q('m4MinZ').textContent=c.min.toFixed(2)+' m';if(q('m4MaxZ'))q('m4MaxZ').textContent=c.max.toFixed(2)+' m';if(q('m4RangeZ'))q('m4RangeZ').textContent=(c.max-c.min).toFixed(2)+' m';if(q('m4ContourCount'))q('m4ContourCount').textContent=String(c.segments.length);m4SetStep(3,true);m4SetStep(4,false);status('تحلیل با موفقیت انجام شد ✓ — خطوط میزان آماده
